title: Cypress Flats LTS
desc: Last chance to tear up the gritty, industrial streets of Cypress Flats before the real estate vultures swoop in there and turn all those factories into luxury lofts. Last Team Standing with 2 teams. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Criminal Records
desc: Drive the hacks insane with some quick, quick laps around the walls of Bolingbroke Penitentiary. You can use a car or a motorbike as long as it's fast.

title: Taking Off
desc: Emergency services are on standby for collisions at this figure of eight track on the runways of Los Santos International Airport. Lap race for four or two wheel vehicles.

title: Down the Drain
desc: Iconic or a cliche - pick up some speed as you race down the dry concrete channel of the LS River. Simple loop laps for land vehicles with two left-hand hairpin turns.

title: Stunt - Chiliad
desc: Mount Chiliad has inspired artists, hippies and death cults for generations, but until now it's offered precious little for the key Los Santos demographic: reckless supercar enthusiasts. All that changes with this towering stunt race over the iconic peak of San Andreas.

title: Arms Race
desc: Before the drones show up and this military base is taken over by robots, use the runways to push your vehicle to its limit. Simple loop lap race for cars and motorbikes at Fort Zancudo.

title: Stunt - Plummet
desc: There's a fine line between an epic descent and falling uncontrollably out of the sky, and which side you're on is going to depend on talent, judgement and just how hard the other guy is trying to kill you. Classic point to point stunt race for super cars.

title: Stunt - Downtown Loop
desc: Halfway through yet another corkscrew above Downtown LS, unable to see anything more than the next 10 feet of track, struggling not to black out, you might find yourself wondering what life choices led you to this point. Because whatever they are, they were clearly excellent. Stunt race for super cars.

title: Dipping In
desc: See the power of stolen water and senseless irrigation at work with this long lap race. Up to sixteen land vehicles can take this track over the hills from leafy Vinewood to the arid Grand Senora.

title: Stunt - Canyon Crossing
desc: White water rafting is for eco-liberals and cowards. Get to know the real Raton Canyon as you plunge through this relentless Stunt Race for super cars with up to fifteen other nature lovers.

title: Across the Wilderness
desc: Discover the great outdoors like your pioneer ancestors did before you, even if that means killing whoever gets in your way. Offroad point to point race through the Paleto forest with a large jump.

title: A Sign of Things to Come
desc: From the stars to the gutter - a motorbike point to point corkscrewing down from the famous sign in Vinewood to the gates of Bolingbroke Penitentiary in the Grand Senora Desert.

title: Over the Hump
desc: An opportunity to get some air over the theme-park canals of Vespucci Beach in this lap race for cars and motorbikes. Starts in Little Seoul.

title: Stunt - Trench I
desc: No, it's not a side effect of your IBS meds, you really are getting tunnel vision, and it's because you're moving at incredible speed through a ten-story tunnel in the middle of nowhere. Self-explanatory stunt race for bikes.

title: Stunt - Double Loop
desc: You can never have too much of a good thing, especially when that thing is a gravity-defying loop-the-loop over Fort Zancudo. Kiss your already fragile grip on the laws of physics goodbye on this intense stunt race for super cars.

title: In the Grove
desc: Starting on Grove Street and heading out of the city, you'll go through Ballas, Families, and Vagos turf in South Los Santos. Point to point for cars or motorbikes.

title: Cutting Coroners
desc: Following the well-beaten path of many an ambulance, this short lap race takes you from South Central Los Santos, by the police station, to the Medical Center, and back out again. Suitable for all land vehicles. Helps if you have a gunshot victim on the back seat.

title: Stunt - Over and Under
desc: As ever in the Golden State, you've got two choices: use every dirty trick in the book to cling to the high life, or duke it out with all the other schmucks in the gutter. You should have gotten good at this by now. Stunt race on two levels for bikes.

title: Stunt - Big Drop
desc: Back on the starting grid you were still a child. By the end of the first descent you were already a man - or possibly a woman, it's hard to tell. By the time you cross the finish line you are, to all intents and purposes, dead. In between, gravity and madness did their work as only a San Andreas stunt race can guarantee. Point to point for sports cars.

title: Stunt - East Coast
desc: When the next planeload of tourists flies into San Andreas, what do you want their first impression to be? The natural drama of cliffs, mountains and ocean? Or you and a bunch of nutjobs driving supercars around a giant wall in the middle of the sea? Thought so.

title: Power Trip
desc: Up to sixteen riders can take part in this motorbike race from the Ron Alternates Wind Farm to the Land Act Dam. Point to point with off-road and road sections.

title: Stunt - City Air
desc: Time to wave to all your friends at the FIB as you get some turbo-charged air time over their HQ. Bonus points if you moon an informant out the passenger window. Stunt race for sports cars over the heart of the city.

title: Stunt - Vespucci
desc: The Los Santos coastline is about so much more than golden sand, contaminated water and steroid abuse. It's also a perfect backdrop for laps of a winding stunt race where any mistake will send you and your million dollar supercar to the bottom of the sea. Hey, it beats the Ferris wheel.

title: Loss Leader
desc: When you put 16 one percenters in a race, only one of them can come out on top. Watch the privileged few try to cheat and outmaneuver each other in this freeway lap race in central Los Santos. Locked to the Zentorno.

title: Stunt - Plummet II
desc: Who hasn't stood in the heart of Los Santos and looked up, past the tops of the skyscrapers, through the blanket of smog, deep into the rapidly deteriorating ozone and thought ''yes, that's an ideal starting point for a stunt race''? Don't get used to the view - you'll be down again real soon. Point to point stunt race for supercars.

title: Stock Market Crash
desc: Short laps, hard corners, and up to sixteen scumbags fighting over the same bonus pool - there'll be some crashes in the financial district when this race kicks off.

title: Stunt - Threading the Needle
desc: Sure, exploding cars and the screams of the dying can be a little distracting. And that six pack of 48hr energy shots you nailed earlier ain't helping. But keeping your focus is your only chance on this tight and technical stunt race for bikes through every level of Los Santos.

title: Greenwich Meantime
desc: Lap race passing Los Santos International, the Maze Bank arena, and Little Seoul. You'll see lots of unused grassland where you might be able to bury a body. Cars and motorbikes. The 'Prepare to Take Off' billboard will separate the women from the girls.

title: Stunt - Lift Off
desc: Enhanced interrogation techniques have come a long way since the early days of putting a black bag over your head and leaving you in a washer dryer for a few hours. If you're not ready to spill your guts after this stunt race for super cars over Fort Zancudo, it's probably because they're busy hosing you off the main runway.

title: Trend Setting
desc: A simple race for simple people who want to seem complicated. Lap circuit for muscle cars around Mirror Park with some long straights on the Los Santos Freeway.

title: Business Trip
desc: Finish the stimulants, down your last Nogo and soda, jump a fast ride, and head for the airport to catch the red eye back home - how every Los Santos expedition ends for the seasoned business traveler. Point to point for up to 16 cars and bikes, starting on the highway and leading to smaller roads.

title: Lost and Found
desc: On ramps, off ramps, road bridges, and freeways. Proof that Los Santos is a city for cars and not much else. Point to point around the road network of East Los Santos. Finishes near the Lost's LS Clubhouse. Cars or motorbikes.

title: Thrills in the Hills
desc: Follow the party trail as you move from the clubs on Eclipse to the mansions and apartment blocks of Rockford Hills and West Vinewood. Wide boulevards going into narrow drives in this lap race for cars and motorcycles.

title: Ring of Fire
desc: From the chilli house to the bacon factory to the LS River, this lap race for cars and motorbikes beats a path around South Los Santos.

title: Stunt - 45°
desc: It's a simple formula, but it works. Keep going till you see the tops of the clouds, then turn left and head downhill for a few miles until the G-force starts to detach your skin from your bones. If you're still alive and conscious after that, well, you're pretty much on your own. Good luck. Lap race for motorcycles.

title: Stunt - Maze Bank Ascent
desc: Close your eyes and get caught up in a fast-moving wave of excitement and optimism that'll take you to the very pinnacle of the banking sector. What goes up never comes crashing down. Seriously, this can only end well. Stunt race for the Sports class.

title: Stunt - H200
desc: After a long day in the office hoping the IT guy won't check your search history, there's nothing more invigorating than the touch of the ocean breeze and the smell of salt water as it washes over a race track and floods your engine. Stunt race for sports cars. Pro tip: bring your bikini bottoms.

title: Stunt - Afterburner
desc: There was a time when jumping through a wreath of flame on a poorly engineered chopper was enough to give even the most jaded patriot a semi. Those simple days are gone, but apply the same formula a thousand feet above an urban area in the middle of the night and you stand a decent chance of a sudden rush of blood to the crotch. Spectacular stunt race for bikes.

title: Stunt - Nightlife
desc: There's nothing quite like driving through Los Santos at night. What the guide books don't tell you is that the best route is an elaborate stunt race, the best altitude is around 2000 feet, and the best vehicle is a twitchy, race-tuned motorbike. Time to break out your Snapmatic.

title: Double Parking
desc: You need a car if you're visiting Los Santos, and you need somewhere to park it when you're not sat stationary in a traffic jam. Race through two parking lots in this simple lap track for compact cars or motorbikes in Little Seoul.

title: Stunt - Over the Bridge
desc: Sure 2000cc superbikes weren't designed to spend this much time flying through the air above industrial docklands, but every step of evolutionary progress is tough on the pioneers. Jump-heavy point to point stunt race.

title: Stunt - Duel
desc: Two groups of crazed speed freaks take two routes around one track competing for one spot at the top of the podium. What could possibly go right? Stunt race for Muscle cars.

title: By the Side of the Bay
desc: Off road point to point starting in the dark heart of Mount Chiliad, shooting down its foothills, rolling through Paleto Bay, and coming to a stop on the white sands of Procopio Beach. Short road section, couple of jumps.

title: Stunt - Racing Alley
desc: When it's not being used as the entry point for half the meth in the state, the Sandy Shores airfield is just the kind of big open space that makes you stop and ask yourself what happens when a pack of fragile sports cars charge into some 30ft bowling pins. Buckle up and watch the magic happen.

title: Stunt - Green Machine
desc: It's the test of a real stunt driver: you can navigate tunnels, jumps, boosts and loops, but can you do it with a bucket's worth of puke on the inside of your windshield? This point-to-point stunt race for super cars is engineered to answer that all-important question, and pretty much nothing else.

title: Stunt - Wall Climb
desc: Every intern at the Union Depository has the same dream as they stare out of their cubicle window: someday, if they work really hard and apply themselves, they'll be the one turbo-charging up the outside of the building with all the other captains of industry and finance. So give 'em something to shoot for on this lap race for super cars.

title: Stunt - Zebra
desc: A few massive slingshots and vertical drops around Mount Chiliad will play havoc with a full stomach. Time to skip lunch... and breakfast... and to pack a change of underwear. Point to Point stunt race for the sports class.

title: Stunt - Raton
desc: They say we have a lot to learn from nature. But once you've seen a dozen hypercars in turbo-charged flight above the Raton Canyon skyline, it seems pretty clear that nature has a lot more to learn from us. Lap race for super cars.

title: Stunt - Big M
desc: Left or right? High road or low road? Strike out alone or stick with the pack? This is a track for members of the free world - because if the American dream is about anything, it's about the freedom to make a series of largely meaningless choices while in a bloodthirsty competition with a bunch of strangers. Lap race for motocycles.

title: Stunt - High Flier
desc: Time to ditch the private jet, saddle up, and learn a thing or two about corporate dominance with this stunt race for bikes through, around and over almost every skyscraper in central LS.

title: Congestion Charge
desc: Everyone in Los Santos knows that public transport is a government conspiracy undermining your freedom to enjoy a 30 car pile-up with other consenting adults. Take a stand for civil liberties on this epic point to point supercar race across most of the freeways in Los Santos. Endurance is the key.

title: Stunt - Turbine
desc: Any old amateur can hit top speed on their way through a fully operational wind farm. What takes really big, dumb balls is seizing every opportunity to get battered out of the sky by a stray turbine arm along the way. Off-road stunt race around RON Alternates. Helmets advised.

title: Stunt - Spinner
desc: It's the kind of board meeting that's at the heart of a rock-solid economy. Just strap yourself into a million dollars of supercar, wash down a handful of plant food with a can of junk, black out whipping round the outside of the Maze Bank Tower, and then make some really sensible investment decisions. Lap race for supercars.

title: Vespucci Dreams
desc: Wide streets, sea breeze, steroid junkies, and LS natives showcasing their latest plastic surgery. You'll see it all in this car and motorcycle lap race around 'laid back' West Los Santos.

title: The First Corporation
desc: Today we worship a false god, the dollar. Spare a thought for simpler times as up to sixteen of you speed past the Church and its congregation in central Los Santos. Short laps for cars and bikes.

title: Rocket Voltic - Atmosphere
desc: You can still remember watching that rocket launch on TV and whispering with excitement ''Mommy, can I be an astronaut?'' And when mommy pointed out that you were a 35-year-old morbidly obese junkie living in her basement, you felt that beautiful dream die a little. Well, time to suit up and show them you're never too old or underqualified to burn up on reentry. Point to point race for the Rocket Voltic.

title: Under the Wing
desc: If you've got a pilot's access all areas pass to the blacktop at Los Santos International, well, you gotta make the most of it. High speed lap race for Sports Classics around the possibly-terminal terminal buildings. Look out for baggage carriers, tight turns, and jet engines.

title: Stunt - Rally
desc: As the next gigantic ramp gives you ten straight seconds of air time over the Grand Senora desert, there's only one question worth asking: why doesn't all rally racing take itself this seriously? Stunt race for the Omnis and Tropos.

title: If I Were a Richman
desc: Lap race up and down the narrow canyon drives of Richman and Rockford Hills. Compact cars and motorbikes on this figure of eight track. Short off road section, but mainly paved.

title: Stunt - Trench III
desc: The problem with outstanding natural beauty is that it can distract you from the perfect racing line. And there's nothing like a six-foot wide, hundred-foot tall trench for keeping your focus firmly on the carcinogenic waste belching out of the superbike in front. Point to point stunt race for motorcycles.

title: Stunt - Forest
desc: The great woodlands of San Andreas are one of our most bountiful resources, providing an endless supply of endangered timber, plenty of discreet hideaways for doomsday cults, and now some of the most suicidal dirt bike jumps in the country. Stunt race for bikes.

title: Stunt - Splits
desc: You are the sum of your choices, so make them count. Inside line or outside line? Red route or yellow route? Steer with your left and crack one off with your right, or the other way round? Stunt race for the Grotti Brioso: this is one for the decision makers.

title: At the Races
desc: Driving a 4x4 around Vinewood Racetrack while someone in short shorts and a monkey mask bays for your blood is the closest any of us are going to get to chariot racing in The Circus Maximus. Give the citizens their bread and games with these straight up, no-excuses laps of the horse track. No togas required.

title: American Cycle
desc: From a towering symbol of Federal control, the FIB Headquarters, to evidence of 'great' individual freedom, Ammu-Nation. Bicycle point to point through Downtown LS with some jumps.

title: Stunt - Trench II
desc: Are you susceptible to paranoia? Feel like the walls are closing in? Often have the sense you're trapped with no escape? Come play this stunt race for muscle cars and give your neuroses something to really latch onto.

title: Gone Fishin'
desc: Off road point to point along the north coast of the Alamo Sea. Some of the prettiest scenery in the State. The locals don't see city folk much, so don't let them catch you alone.

title: Mud, Sweat and Gears
desc: Fill your cooler with some Logger Lites, grab your hunting rifle, and throw them in the back of your monster truck. It's time to go back to nature and remember what this nation is all about. Point to point race on dirt roads crossing creeks and going over Mount Josiah.

title: Stunt - Around the Docks
desc: You can find anything you want at the LS docklands if you look hard enough. Cut price hallucinogens? Check. Bargain basement STIs? Check. Unlicensed cosmetic surgeons? Check. A stunt race with enough ups, downs, tilts and drops to make you need all of the above? Check, check, check. Lapped race for motorcycles.

title: Rocket Voltic - Ascent
desc: Ah, the things you'll do to earn that promotion. Climb the boss's slippery pole. Get a head with the director. Join the shareholders as they hurl their Rocket Voltics through a lap race over the summit of the Maze Bank Tower. Really, honestly, you'll just climb forever, like the housing market.

title: Dorset Drive
desc: Take your baby for a drive with this lap race for cars and bikes around glamorous Vinewood studios, romantic Vespucci Canals, and glitzy Rockford Hills mansions. But remember, baby likes a winner.

title: Ace Liquor
desc: If you thought Sandy Shores couldn't get any shadier, try this deathmatch around Ace Liquor and the gas station. Trevor and Chef aren't cooking, thankfully.

title: Stunt - The Wave
desc: Who said you have to venture out into the middle of the Pacific in a force ten gale to feel so sea sick you want to die? That special inside out feeling is available right here on this coastal stunt race for bikes.

title: Learning Curve
desc: Help students swap their college debt for medical bills in this lap race starting on the ULSA campus. Track covers the wide roads and narrow canyon drives of Rockford Hills. For cars and motorbikes.

title: Rocket Voltic - Bumblebee
desc: Ever since the acid told you that yellow and black lizard was a corn on the cob, you've known an attractive color scheme when you see one. This time, it's a rocket-propelled super car and 3000 foot drop, but you get the idea: book a place in the ER, and take a bite. Lap race for the Rocket Voltic.

title: Morning Perm-a-wood
desc: Circuit around Morningwood and Backlot City taking you down wide drives, narrow alleyways, and tight canyon roads. Lap race for motorbikes.

title: Maze
desc: Get lost at the Kortz Center. Deathmatch that works best with teams in the maze on top of Los Santos. You're more likely to find a confused tourist or someone who wants to shoot you in the face than a way out of this labyrinth slash monument to arch capitalist dynasties.

title: Stunt - In the City
desc: You do what you need to do to get ahead. Whether that's extortion, prostitution, or winning a brutal stunt race for sports cars in, through, round and over every landmark in the Los Santos business district. And hey, no one said you couldn't do all three.

title: Bluffing
desc: Off road lap race in Pacific Bluffs. Race in a loop along the lower roads, the beachfront, and under the historic Chumash family pier. Jumps and tight turns. Avoid the rocks on the beach and through the tight gap under the pier.

title: Stunt - Vinewood Downhill
desc: Give it the D. Put the D in Vinewood. Get up close and personal with a massive D. Drive a motorbike at breakneck speed through the D of the Vinewood sign. Surprisingly, that last one is not a joke. You know what to do. Stunt Point to Point for bikes.

title: Dock Ring
desc: Like a trucker, hit the blacktop and keep going 'til you run outta gas. Land vehicle point to point that loops through the Port of LS and gets on the freeway all the way to the San Chianski Mountains.

title: Tour the Lake
desc: From sea to shining sea - appreciate the scuzzy, meth ravaged, recession-beaten beauty of this great nation with a point to point for Sovereign bikes. Starts at the Alamo Sea and ends at the Alamo Sea.

title: Tunnel Vision
desc: Ride the wall in this motorcycle point to point that loops through the metro tunnels under Los Santos International Airport.

title: Art to Art
desc: Point to point motorbike race through North-Western Los Santos, starting above the city at the Kortz Center, and finishing in the heart of old downtown, Legion Square.

title: Stunt - Gauntlet
desc: Somewhere thousands of feet above the Pacific Ocean, up there with migrating birds and the government-financed chemtrails, there's a nutjob falling out of the sky in a million-dollar supercar. But there's a smile on his face, because he's winning. That nutjob could be you. Believe. Lapped race for supercars.

title: Stadium Tour
desc: City planning at its finest - negotiate the complex system of freeway interchanges around Los Santos International Airport in this lap race for cars and motorcycles. Then be grateful you're not late for a flight at rush hour or on the way to a concert at the Maze Bank Arena.

title: Quick Getaway
desc: Like some crooks in a hurry, take motorbikes off the Del Perro Freeway, through the metro tunnel excavation, and into the channel of the LS River. Largely subterranean point to point race.

title: CyclePath
desc: Every Los Santos tourist has to take a bike ride along the beach from Del Perro to Vespucci. Point to point follows the cycle path and cuts inland. Passes Muscle Sands, where men have been swapping insecurities for steroid addiction since the 1930s.

title: Stunt - Pier Race
desc: The Ferris wheels and the Roller coasters are all very nice, but you're looking for the wholesome family day out you couldn't get anywhere else. Drop your candy edibles, fight your way past the buskers and the tourists, and jump on board this brutal little off-shore stunt race for super cars.

title: Rocket Voltic - The Loop
desc: When it comes to using the spaceship part that's been welded to the back of your open-top super car to boost you around a loop-the-loop the size of a skyscraper, subtlety is everything. Lap race for the Rocket Voltic.

title: Rocket Voltic - Pulse
desc: This is no ordinary comedown. Sure, the bright, pulsing lights are there, tapering off to the familiar, migraine-inducing point. But the usual sense of complete disorientation is accompanied by spine-crushing momentum, and your hands are holding some kind of wheel. Yep, there's only one conclusion: you're coming to your senses on a point-to-point stunt race for the Rocket Voltic. Good luck - you'll need it.

title: Delta V
desc: Because man's first instinct when he sees an area of natural beauty is to burn through it as fast as he can churning emissions into the atmosphere and leaking oil and gas into the water, here's a Seashark race through the Zancudo Wetlands. Try to avoid getting beached on the tight turns.

title: Into the Lights
desc: Take a path down the North face of the Vinewood Hills going from the Gallileo Observatory to the Redwood Lights Motocross Track. Point to point motorbike race with off road and paved sections.

title: Staying on Track
desc: Track winding and weaving through the alleys, lots, and lanes of Industrial East Los Santos. Lap race on motorbikes.

title: Stunt - Mountain Drop
desc: At some point, every wannabe rally driver in Los Santos has found themselves burning to death in a very expensive supercar halfway down Mount Chiliad. Well break out your flame-retardant suit, because this time you're going to need track precision, off-road reflexes and the ability to fly a superbike like it's an attack chopper. Point to point stunt race for motorcycles.

title: The Los Santos Triangle
desc: This challenging short lap race puts your corning skills to the test. Four sharp turns stand between you and the finish line.

title: Rocket Voltic - Zebra II
desc: Since the first caveman jumped off a cliff in a futile bid to get laid, man has dreamed of flight. The perfect freedom, the solitude, the silence. Well, now that dream is real. Only you're strapped into the love child of a super car and a space shuttle, there's 15 other grinning lunatics on every side of you, and all you can hear are explosions and screams. So quite a bit better, if anything. Lap race for the Rocket Voltic.

title: Grass Route II
desc: Sequel to smash hit Grass Route, this off road point to point starts on the North bank of the Zancudo River, passes through the wetlands, and finishes on the beach in North Chumash. Expect some of the same dirt road hijinks you enjoyed the first time around.

title: Off the Rails
desc: Starting near the Procopico Truck stop in Northern Blaine County, race along the railway to Humane Labs and Research on the Eastern Coast. Point to Point on motorbikes.

title: Touch Base
desc: Sixteen rider motorcycle point to point, corkscrewing down from the hills near the Galileo Observatory to the gates of Fort Zancudo. Road and off road sections.

title: Redwood Light District
desc: Fulfill your childhood dream of competing on the Redwood Lights Motocross Track. Lap race on dirt bikes with multiple jumps.

title: Before It Was Cool
desc: Any skinny jeans wearer will know, sometimes things just don't fit. Try and squeeze up to eight compact cars around the tight corners of this lap race in Mirror Park.

title: Cream of the Crop
desc: Lap race around the farms, fields, moonshine stills, and meth labs of rural Blaine County. Flat motorbike track circling Grapeseed with road and off road sections.

title: Turn the Tide
desc: Hug the waterline with this off road point to point starting on Procopio Beach. Up to sixteen racers can follow the North coast down through Paleto State Beach to Paleto Cove.

title: Swamp Monster
desc: America isn't just a place, it's an idea. Show nature who's boss by crushing it under your sixty inch tires, and spewing exhaust in its face. Lap race for monster trucks in area of natural beauty, but not for much longer, Lago Zancudo.

title: Free Fall
desc: Lap race for dirt bikes going up and down the Blaine County side of the Vinewood Hills. Features road and off road sections, and a large jump.

title: On the Trail
desc: A tour through San Andreas Wilderness at its best. Go from Raton Canyon to Paleto Bay with this motorcycle point to point on dirt tracks, river beds, highways, and beaches.

title: Raton Race
desc: Knock the canyon's dharma out of line in this point to point race. Perilous track for off road vehicles featuring lots of cliff-edge tight turns. Ends on the shore of the Alamo Sea.

title: Caffeine Rush
desc: If your friends caught you drinking anything except a flat white at an independent coffee house it would be social suicide, but when you need java, you need java. Point to Point sedan race from Del Perro to Mirror Park passing four 'Cool Beans' coffee shops. At least it's not Bean Machine.

title: In Harmony
desc: Some tight turns in this off-roader lap race in the Grand Senora Desert. You'll go over dirt roads, narrow paths, paved sections, and jumps as you pass the Redwood Lights Track and the Rebel Radio radio tower.

title: Code 13-91
desc: Urban race with jumps, tight sections and lots of obstacles! Watch out for the Paris-Marseille union!

title: Going Down
desc: Motorbike race starting in the narrow canyon roads of chichi Rockford Hills, and ending in wide boulevards of scuzzy Downtown Vinewood. Point to point with an opportunity to take flight.

title: Brand's Snatch
desc: Stay on your toes through turns of all speeds and sizes. Circuit-style course best suited for experienced drivers - watch for the slalom!

title: Wiwang Park
desc: In the late 80s and early 90s, we thought East Asia would take over the world, starting with some high rise office blocks in West LS. But a decade of economic crisis followed instead. Race like a master of the universe in this short lap circuit around the Wiwang Tower. For cars and bikes.

title: Canals
desc: After this deathmatch, there'll be blood in the Vespucci canals... alongside the usual quinoa packets and cannabis prescription bottles. Fight through the alleyways, waterways, and apartment blocks of the city's most champagne-happy neighborhood.

title: Battle of the Alamo LTS
desc: Nothing ups the tension when you're dogfighting fighter jets like doing it over one of the most toxic bodies of water in the USA. Bail out at your own risk. Last Team Standing with 2 teams. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Driving Range
desc: Much better use of a golf course than actually playing golf or talking about how much money you have. Race caddies around the links in this lap race and watch out for the water hazard.

title: Rocket Voltic - Redneck
desc: Sometimes, it's only when we strip things back to basics that we discover who we really are. Take this finely tuned, perfectly simple speed circuit for the Rocket Voltic, for example: it's only when you're halfway round the last lap, fighting the urge to black out, and some asshat spins you out into fiery oblivion, that you discover how questionable your basic decision making is. Baby steps.

title: Peak Performance
desc: Dom-inate this steep descent from the peak of Mount Chiliad to the side of the GOH. Point to point bicycle race.

title: On Yer Bike
desc: Eight rider bicycle descent from the Vinewood sign to Vinewood itself. Pick up serious speed in the road and off road sections, and get some air on the large jumps.

title: Gone Coastal
desc: Point to point for boats starting in the LS River, and taking you to the Palomino Highlands on the East Coast. Hugs the coastline, but features some turns and opportunities to jump rocks and islets.

title: Sumo (Remix) IV
desc: It's time to brush off your territorial instincts in this remix of the classic adversary mode. The bottom line is the same: be in the safe zone when the timer runs out - or prepare to overheat, permanently. But this time, as well as getting smaller, the safe zone changes location every time the clock resets, and bits of the track might disappear at random. Stay sharp.

title: Street Race - Country Pursuits
desc: Everyone dreams of leaving their small town for the big city. But you? You bring the big city to the small town, including the all-out precision racing, traffic law violations and horrifying injuries. Better hope The Bay Care Center is well equipped. Lap race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Street Race - The Business End
desc: Pay cuts, lack of safety equipment, Taco Bomb Tuesdays abolished, and now street racers juiced on cans of Junk are cutting through the construction site. These contractors are just one failed handbrake turn away from federal investigation and becoming a legend of the San Andreas racing circuit. Lap race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Street Race - Beachfront Runner
desc: You know how to party in Del Perro. Beat LS's legendary drivers in a breakneck street race, slam some cocktails at Bahama Mamas, blackout on the dancefloor, and wake up spewing cotton candy on Pleasure Pier. Time to initiate phase one. Lap race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Ruiner 2000 - Steeplechase
desc: Face it, you only watch horse racing to see if anyone falls off and breaks their neck. So why not raise the stakes a little? Jumping, hopping and parachuting two tons of modified muscle car from one precarious, obstacle-filled ledge to another 1000 feet above the city seems like the logical next step. Point to point stunt race for the Ruiner 2000.

title: Street Race - Home Street Home
desc: You know the score: You grew up on the streets of Strawberry. You race on the streets of Strawberry. And one day they'll scrape you off the streets of Strawberry. Get ready for your whole life to flash before your eyes. Lap race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Horse Power
desc: Dirt bike race through the O'Neil Ranch in rural Grapeseed. Quick and dirty just like the crank cooked there. Short laps and a jump.

title: Shore Up
desc: Short lap race starting in idyllic beachside retirement community, Sandy Shores. Jumps on and off road and features a tight section through rocks and detritus spat up by the Alamo Sea.

title: Street Race - Up Your Alley
desc: Careering down the alleyways of Mission Row, you'll always find one of three things. 1) A mugging. 2) A handjob. 3) A street race shortcut. Fingers crossed for number three and/or number two. Lap race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Blazer Aqua - Beach Party
desc: The coastline of San Andreas is the nation's unofficial national park, and we need to do everything we can to protect it from lobbying groups of ruthless environmentalists who want to limit our freedom to stage really epic stunt races there. Point to point race for the Blazer Aqua.

title: Ruiner 2000 - Night Ride
desc: This isn't just a race: it's a mission. Break out the leather jacket and the chest wig, and get ready for a series of improbable stunts, sexual conquests, and technology so smart there's no good reason why it hasn't stolen your job. Lap race for the Ruiner 2000.

title: Bahama West Mama Mia!
desc: 0.64mi lap race through some tight alleys.

title: The City Commute
desc: Your alarm should have gone off hours ago, your mouth tastes like a donkey pissed in it (because one did), and you've got a marketing presentation in ten minutes - point to point from the suburbs to the city for cars and bikes.

title: Sundae Driving
desc: Short looping race around the Vespucci Beach promenade and nearby roads. Suitable for all motorcycles, tourists and wackos.

title: Up the Back Alley
desc: Compact car circuit around scuzzy-chic Downtown Vinewood. Watch out for frat boy tourists and reality TV shoots. Lap race with some tight sections in alleyways.

title: Mansion
desc: Tennis court, pool, views over the city, lakeside location - only no-one wants to buy it 'cause so many people have been killed in the grounds. Deathmatch that works best with teams in this Vinewood Hills dream home you might just be able to afford now.

title: Without a Paddle
desc: San Andreas at its most scenic, particularly when it's not raining fire. Race boats down the rapids of Raton Canyon in a point to point that takes you from the Ocean to the Alamo Sea.

title: Ruiner 2000 - Criss Cross
desc: Like your pa always said: when the floodwaters come, you're the kind of human skid mark no one is going to miss. But where would you rather be on judgment day? Swept out to sea with nothing but a posing pouch full of regrets? Or racing, jumping and flying a muscle car through the LS Storm Drain, just a couple of seconds ahead of the tide? Lap race for the Ruiner 2000.

title: Trailer Park
desc: Deathmatch in a Grand Senora trailer park. Unspoiled desert living (and dying) if you ignore the transmission towers, utility poles, satellite dishes, wind farm, train line, and maximum security prison in the distance.

title: Street Race - High Society
desc: The community council of Rockford Hills have issued a formal complaint over the reckless racing in their good, god-fearing American streets. There's only one rational response. Settle into the power-slide, pull down your pants, and drop a fat deuce out of the window as you pass the AGM. Lap race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Ruiner 2000 - Damned
desc: Moving from the Land Act Reservoir to central LS faster than an outbreak of typhoid, this is a race for anyone who enjoys watching the competition hop neatly over an obstacle and straight into a death spiral, or glide gracefully into a toxic lake. Use every trick in the book to get your Ruiner 2000 to the end of this point to point race.

title: Blazer Aqua - Water Slide
desc: When you think of water sports, you think of jacking off in the shower, or that time you tried to piss on a Russian spy and got some in your mouth. Time to expand your nautical horizons with this lap race for the Blazer Aqua around Lake Vinewood.

title: Chasing Shots
desc: You'll work better in teams on this deathmatch around the Vanilla Unicorn Gentleman's Club. Leon, the manager, will have some questions for you if you get too friendly with the girls, but don't worry, he'll chill out soon enough.

title: Street Race - Back at the Rancho
desc: This high-octane street race is the most exciting cultural event to hit Rancho since the reshoot of Die Already 4. Although, the body count is expected to be just as high. Lap race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Blowing in the Wind
desc: A tour of San Andreas' renewable energy infrastructure in the least green vehicles we could think of - planes. Point to point starts in Sandy Shores, dives through the windfarm, comes up over the Land Act Dam, and finishes Downtown.

title: HIPSTER DEATH RALLY
desc: HIPSTER RALLY RACE OF DEATH !

title: Field Trip
desc: Where Los Santos meets the old West - race off roaders through oil fields and junk yards in this lap circuit. Only a matter of time until this area is turned into shopping malls, or hipster hangouts, so enjoy it while you can. Great views.

title: Ruiner 2000 - Tube Rider
desc: How can you prepare for a fast-paced journey through an obstacle filled death-tube? Well, think back to that emergency colonoscopy you had to pretend you didn't enjoy. Turns out you're set. Lap race for the Ruiner 2000.

title: Cranes
desc: Drop in over Pillbox Hill from 1650ft and navigate sharp turns through all the unfinished construction projects from the good old days before the economy tanked.

title: Heart Braker
desc: Make your feelings known by carving a love heart into the Grand Senora Desert. Hills and jumps in this mainly off road lap race for bikes on a heart-shaped track.

title: Up the Creek
desc: Dirt bike point to point going along Cassidy Creek and ending at the Alamo Sea. Road section on the Great Ocean Highway and jumps onto, and out of, North Chumash Beach.

title: Sumo (Remix) I
desc: It's time to brush off your territorial instincts in this remix of the classic adversary mode. The bottom line is the same: be in the safe zone when the timer runs out - or prepare to overheat, permanently. But this time, as well as getting smaller, the safe zone changes location every time the clock resets, and bits of the track might disappear at random. Stay sharp.

title: Boatyard
desc: What do you do with the boatyards and fishing towns on the Alamo Sea when the water's become so salinated that all the fish are dead? Use them for a deathmatch. Fight it out in the barns and boathouses of Blaine County's Galilee.

title: Eight Figure Bonus
desc: High speed figure of eight laps through scuzzy Downtown and Industrial East Los Santos. Up to 30 cars - defaulting to Sports Class, because the type of person who drives one likes to speed past the disadvantaged, usually spitting out the window.

title: Sumo (Remix) VI
desc: It's time to brush off your territorial instincts in this remix of the classic adversary mode. The bottom line is the same: be in the safe zone when the timer runs out - or prepare to overheat, permanently. But this time, as well as getting smaller, the safe zone changes location every time the clock resets, and bits of the track might disappear at random. Stay sharp.

title: Sumo (Remix) II
desc: It's time to brush off your territorial instincts in this remix of the classic adversary mode. The bottom line is the same: be in the safe zone when the timer runs out - or prepare to overheat, permanently. But this time, as well as getting smaller, the safe zone changes location every time the clock resets, and bits of the track might disappear at random. Stay sharp.

title: Muscle In
desc: Navigating a claustrophobic inner-city figure of eight requires non-stop concentration and flawless technique, which is why you're doing it in a turbo-charged muscle car with wholly theoretical steering. Take a deep breath for the hairpin turns and crossovers: your only crumple zone is your self-esteem.

title: Home In The Hills
desc: Beat the rush hour traffic from workplace yuppie central to... residential yuppie central. Point to point starting outside Maze Bank and finishing in the Vinewood Hills.

title: The Coil
desc: 2 laps inside the rings at the airport.

title: Cult Following
desc: If you think the way up to the Altruists is dangerous, try this treacherous path down from their camp. Hold onto the foothills of Mount Chiliad all the way to Cassidy Creek in Raton Canyon. Watch out for the perilous cliff-edge turns after emerging from the long tunnel leading out to the Alamo Sea. Point to point race for dirt bikes.

title: Up In the Clouds
desc: A mid-paced jump from 4100ft into central Los Santos with sweeping, shallow turns so, even if you're screaming like a baby in the air, you'll still look cool and graceful from the ground.

title: A Ridge Too Far
desc: Don't let the Alamo Sea sunrise in front of you distract you from what's 4000ft below - the blood and guts of your competitors on the cliffs of Mount Josiah. Only glory-hungry fools attempt to freefall the final ridge run of this merciless jump. You're not interested in glory, right?

title: Barnstorming
desc: When not cooking crank or sleeping with their sister, the O'Neil brothers set up obstacle courses... apparently. Point to point for bicycles through their ranch in Grapeseed farmland. Jumps.

title: Shotgun Wedding
desc: The title says it all. Small-scale deathmatch around the church in Paleto Bay that's locked to shotguns. It'll be a lot less bloody than divorce.

title: In the Pipeline
desc: From Vespucci Beach to Chumash, tour some of Los Santos' stretches of coastline with this sixteen rider dirt bike point to point. Starts at the Pipeline Inn and goes inland.

title: Loop the Lake
desc: Circuit like lap race around the water in Vinewood Hills.

title: Base Level
desc: Play chicken and dodge ducks with this race over Lago Zancudo. Lap course for Besra stunt jets that cuts back over itself multiple times. Expect to see wreckage in the wetlands and impact zones on the bridges.

title: Carnage I
desc: There's no need to overcomplicate things: Americans have always known how to have good, old fashioned, rats-in-a-sack, murder-orgy fun. All we need to do is provide a fresh and unpredictable set of tools, roll the cameras, and get the hell out of the way. No mercy, no disqualification, no safe word.

title: Hydro
desc: Enjoy panoramic views that start off stunning and steadily deteriorate until you land at a power plant on the side of a freeway. A 2740ft jump that dives steeply over the hydro-electric station.

title: Downtown
desc: Deathmatch in the sloping backyards, parking lots, and loading bays between Spanish Ave and Vinewood Blvd in Downtown Vinewood. No matter how many participants get shot, the leading cause of death here will still be overdose.

title: RAMPS! RAMPS! RAMPS!
desc: NO MAX MONEY!! NO MAX RP!! IT'S JUST FOR FUN!!! I recommend 7 players or more. The more the merrier for this one so extend the time and please be patient!

title: Legal Eagle
desc: Business as usual between the FIB and IAA buildings in Downtown Los Santos as two teams attack each other for no particular reason. Deathmatch in the shadow of the silver eagle statue.

title: Ruiner 2000 - Target
desc: If gliding a hi-tech prototype muscle car over a mile of open country and onto a small platform isn't building up transferable skills, then what is? There's a reason San Andreas produces more drone pilots than any other state - and it's called investing in people. Lap race for the Ruiner 2000.

title: The Slipstream GP
desc: Slipstream Mode in HD!!!!!!!!!!!!

title: Beach
desc: There are so many posers in Del Perro, you need to up your game to stand out. This descent onto the beach from 4970ft with wide sweeping turns should get you noticed.

title: Crossfire
desc: Based on the gun crime levels in Los Santos and Blaine County, you'd be forgiven for asking where they store all those bullets. See for yourself with this deathmatch by the Ammu-Nation warehouses in Cypress Flats. Works best with teams.

title: Kortz LTS
desc: Treat the Kortz Center museum to some performance art that truly captures the conflict of the human condition for once. Last Team Standing with 2 teams. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Against the Grain
desc: Challenging figure of eight track through the seaside farms, fields, and other immigrant labor exploitation spots outside Paleto Bay in Northern Southern San Andreas. Lap race on dirt bikes.

title: Blazer Aqua - Into the Dam
desc: A little-known alternative to the traditional night-time bombing raid is hurling 16 fully disposable morons out of the sky on amphibious quad bikes in the middle of the day and hoping for the best. Strap in, it's time to serve. Lap race for the Blazer Aqua.

title: Blazer Aqua - Island Hopping
desc: It takes thousands of years to build up a delicately balanced ecosystem of island-dwelling flora and fauna. And it'll take you roughly one lap of this stunt race to leave pretty much nothing alive except a partially deafened sea-turtle. Lap race for the Blazer Aqua.

title: Panto-monium Microcircuit
desc: The Panto: possessing all the pretension and pomposity of a Benefactor, the smug, self-satisfaction of a Dilettante, combined with the thrill and badassery of a go-kart.  It's Panto-monium on the streets of Murrieta Heights with up to eight hipsters in denial, racing microcars on this microcircuit.

title: Adrift
desc: Get spiritual, face your fears, soil yourself...this one has it all. A jump from 7870ft that combines a rapid descent with some challenging turns.

title: Wreck It II
desc: It's theoretically possible to win a round of Wreck It by crossing the line first in a fair-and-square lap race. But don't worry: that's never happened, because the alternative is coasting across the line after you've reduced any serious competition to heaps of smoldering scrap metal. Like the old saying goes, if it's not a race to the death, you're just not taking it seriously enough.

title: Ruiner 2000 - Drop Ship
desc: The jumps, the lifts, the swoops, the glides: this is beauty, this is technique, this is majesty. If pneumatic, flying cars had been around when they invented ballet, it'd have been a toss-up between this and the dudes in tights. Lap race for the Ruiner 2000.

title: Burn Your Bridges
desc: It's duck season in this lap race for Mallard planes around South Los Santos. Fly through the thick of the smog as you buzz chimney stacks and gas guzzling freeways, and go under and between bridges in the city's soon to be outsourced industrial heart.

title: Wreck It III
desc: It's theoretically possible to win a round of Wreck It by crossing the line first in a fair-and-square lap race. But don't worry: that's never happened, because the alternative is coasting across the line after you've reduced any serious competition to heaps of smoldering scrap metal. Like the old saying goes, if it's not a race to the death, you're just not taking it seriously enough.

title: That's What She Said
desc: Jumping on the dock in a sports car.

title: Gorge
desc: Become one with nature as you plummet through the Mount Chiliad Gorge from 3100ft, and pray that a gust of wind doesn't make you become one with the rock face.

title: The Dam Before the Storm
desc: Challenging dirt bike point to point. Hold it together on this steep descent from the top of the Land Act Dam to the basin of the LS River in East Los Santos.

title: Jet Lag
desc: Long point to point race for Lazers. Fighter jets will start at Fort Zancudo and go over the wetlands before coming over the Vinewood Hills rounding Downtown and finishing above Del Perro. Pilots have to go between buildings and under bridges at high speed.

title: Over the Hill
desc: As the duck flies, race Mallards from El Gordo Lighthouse to the West of San Andreas, and then back to the Alamo Sea. Point to point for stunt planes taking you over San Andreas' highest point, the peak of Mount Chiliad.

title: Blazer Aqua - Storm Drain
desc: Forgotten to have your booster shots? Sporting any open wounds? Got any residual standards of personal hygiene or a functioning sense of smell? If the answer to any of those is 'yes' then this lap race for the Blazer Aqua through the LS River might not be for you. Otherwise, dive in.

title: Chamberlain Hills
desc: Deathmatch for the Chamberlain Gangster Families. Fight in the roads and on the roof tops of the quiet, suburban, but not-so-safe neighborhood, Chamberlain Hills. Deathmatch that works best for teams near Franklin and Denise's house.

title: Del Perro Pier LTS
desc: Forget the rollercoaster and the ferris wheel, create your own fun at the Del Perro Pier with the kind of thrill ride that will scare the tourists off for good. Last Team Standing with 2 teams. You've got one life, don't waste it.

title: Hit The Apex
desc: Nothing beats the thrill of throwing a fast car around corners at high speeds. Get the adrenaline pumping in this long twisty circuit, enjoy the ride.

title: Turn to Dust
desc: This dustbowl was once arable farmland supporting dozens of homespun rural communities, which made it terrible for off-roading. Shake off the depression and make the sand dunes work for you on laps of this tight Sanchez race by the Alamo Sea. Remember, we're optimists, so the glass is half full, even when it's half full of dust.

title: Hot Bomb I
desc: Life isn't about holding onto good things, it's about passing them on. Like inherited wealth, or a sense of entitlement. Or a high-explosive device. In Hot Bomb, one player has the bomb, and the only way to get rid of it is by crashing into someone else. Throw in a timer and a baying crowd, and survival of the fittest just got an upgrade.

title: Cliffs
desc: Take a steep dive from 4155ft down the craggy North side of Mount Chiliad, glide in over a homeless camp to remind you why you live each minute like it's your last, then land on a spectacular beach to remind you why you live on the West Coasts.

title: Tittie Twister
desc: What.

title: Derelict Motel
desc: Great place for a tina party, emo vandalism or a deathmatch - teams are recommended for this fight in a burnt out motel in Sandy Shores. No prizes for guessing why the Alamo Sea tourist industry died out. Hint: it wasn't the recession.

title: Concrete
desc: You don't need to be Families, Ballas, Vagos, LSPD, or a girl scout to get involved in this deathmatch in South Central's shopping district. Fight through the alleyways and parking lots then stop for some high-quality fast food.

title: Stunt - Vicious Spiral
desc: How much G-force is too much G-force, and wouldn't you like to know first-hand? If you answered "there's no such thing" and "hell yeah" then you're the ideal participant to run in this phase 2 clinical trial. You can rest assured the scientific findings will be greatly appreciated when they scoop you out the driver's seat. Stunt race for supercars.

title: Getaway
desc: Rather than looking around and silently judging fellow guests at your country club, you can act out your bloodiest fantasies on them. Deathmatch that works best with teams at this exclusive members only joint on the beach in Pacific Bluffs.

title: The 80's Turf War
desc: The 2 gangs collide once again but this time in 80's style.

title: Pier
desc: Fun for the whole gang on Del Perro Pier with this deathmatch. Fight in the parking lot, the overpriced al fresco dining establishments, and next to the carnival games. Works best with teams.

title: Carnage II
desc: There's no need to overcomplicate things: Americans have always known how to have good, old fashioned, rats-in-a-sack, murder-orgy fun. All we need to do is provide a fresh and unpredictable set of tools, roll the cameras, and get the hell out of the way. No mercy, no disqualification, no safe word.

title: Black and Yellow
desc: Careful not to get stung on this thrilling dash above Paleto Cove - a distinctively coloured Stunt Race full of tight turns and narrow dashes.

title: Wreck It I
desc: It's theoretically possible to win a round of Wreck It by crossing the line first in a fair-and-square lap race. But don't worry: that's never happened, because the alternative is coasting across the line after you've reduced any serious competition to heaps of smoldering scrap metal. Like the old saying goes, if it's not a race to the death, you're just not taking it seriously enough.

title: The Shed
desc: It's you and a flimsy piece of material against Nature as you weave down the side of Mount Chiliad from 3425ft.

title: On the GOH
desc: The first time you almost plunge off a cliff, you'll forget about the stunning views and start to concentrate on the road. Dozens of hysterical city-dwellers compete for a small patch of asphalt in this long lap race for sports cars on the Great Ocean Highway and Banham Canyon.

title: Back Alley
desc: Small town USA deathmatch in recession-hit Paleto Bay. Fight in the little used loading bays of the not so thriving shopping district. At least the funeral parlor will see some business. Works best with teams.

title: Ocean Flyby
desc: Enjoy breathtaking views as you glide in over the El Gordo Lighthouse and land on an island off the coast of the San Chianski Mountain Range...then wish you'd come up with a better plan for getting home. A 3595ft jump with shallow to medium turns.

title: Dubsta Warz
desc: Got yourself the high ranking new Dubsta? It will come in handy when racing over the steep hills of Los Santos County, if you're a low rank or well.... poor then you'll have to settle for a Sandking, sorry. Pure off-road point to point for 8 players.

title: Hot Bomb II
desc: Life isn't about holding onto good things, it's about passing them on. Like inherited wealth, or a sense of entitlement. Or a high-explosive device. In Hot Bomb, one player has the bomb, and the only way to get rid of it is by crashing into someone else. Throw in a timer and a baying crowd, and survival of the fittest just got an upgrade.

title: Blazer Aqua - Surf and Turf
desc: What falls faster: 400 pounds of amphibious quad bike, 200 pounds of dough-brained adrenaline junkie, or a mouthful of terror-vomit? You've got ten seconds to freefall towards the Pacific to find out. Spoiler: you aren't going to outpace the vomit. Lap race for the Blazer Aqua.

title: Hot Bomb III
desc: Life isn't about holding onto good things, it's about passing them on. Like inherited wealth, or a sense of entitlement. Or a high-explosive device. In Hot Bomb, one player has the bomb, and the only way to get rid of it is by crashing into someone else. Throw in a timer and a baying crowd, and survival of the fittest just got an upgrade.

title: Reservoir
desc: Get a whiff of what your drinking water smells like before it hits the treatment plant as you glide in over the Land Act Reservoir. A leisurely jump from 1655ft with very shallow turns.

title: Plane to Sea
desc: Play crop duster on this mountain hugging, crevasse diving point to point for planes. From Procopio, go around Mount Gordo, and over Grapeseed's dusty farmland. Bringing out of date pesticide and a disregard for immigrant laborers is optional.

title: Business Class
desc: Do Loggins proud and race some fighter jets around Downtown LS and Vinewood. Weave between buildings and through construction sites on your laps. Two tight turns at either end.

title: Loose Canyon
desc: Figure of eight airtrack between the Alamo Sea and the Ocean. Laps follow Cassidy Creek, loop around Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness and come back. Pilots have to fly under three bridges.

title: Beachfront
desc: The tourists come to Vespucci for a freak show, so give them what they want with a deathmatch along the beachfront. By the time they realize it isn't pop-up performance art, it'll be too late.

title: Stunt - City Limits
desc: Clear your throat, loosen your tie, and inform the AGM that you will finish strategizing as you hit G-force. It's time to take business outside. Is anyone taking notes? Stunt race for supercars.

title: Alta LTS
desc: Less violent than the average apartment building residents' committee meeting, this cramped LTS pits two wings of a building against each other. Try to stay on the rooftops, and look for long-ranged attacks across the courtyard and close-quarters clashes on the footbridge.

title: Lazer Quest
desc: Have you got the right stuff to take laps around Blaine County with this race for fighter jets. Starts near Sandy Shores, goes through Grapeseed, along the North coast of the Alamo Sea, around Mount Jonah, and back down Raton Canyon toward the Grand Senora.

title: Rocket Kars
desc: Fight for first place and gasps of air in this cloud-top celebration of Stunt Races - stick to the track and don't look down!

title: Skyscraper
desc: At 7870ft, far above the clouds, this jump will tap right into your god complex. A descent with wide sweeping turns and multiple dives, landing on top of the Maze Bank building.

title: Pillbox Hill
desc: Multi-level deathmatch for teams, at the high-rise development in Pillbox Hill. Almost certainly green-lighted before the credit crunch and collapse of the San Andreas economy, so pre-purchase condos are still available.

title: Pier 400
desc: Be the fastest moving vessels Los Santos harbor has seen in a while in this point to point race for boats. Pass container ships, Port City, and the Airport. Possible jump if it's worth the risk.

title: Sumo (Remix) V
desc: It's time to brush off your territorial instincts in this remix of the classic adversary mode. The bottom line is the same: be in the safe zone when the timer runs out - or prepare to overheat, permanently. But this time, as well as getting smaller, the safe zone changes location every time the clock resets, and bits of the track might disappear at random. Stay sharp.

title: Over the Globe
desc: Either jump at night, or bring your factor 500 tanning lotion, because the sun shines a lot brighter at 7870ft. A technical jump with numerous tight turns and fast dives.

title: Love Canyon
desc: Rocket down Raton Canyon and enjoy the views from the climb up Mount Josiah, before an unforgettable final stretch.

title: Buzzer Beater II
desc: If the years you've spent on the couch lurching from sugar coma to sugar coma have taught you anything, it's this: no deadline, no motivation. Strap a few pounds of high explosive to that deadline, give a small extension for every checkpoint you hit, throw in bonus points for random violence and an audience of millions, and your productivity is about to go through the roof.

title: Truss Issues
desc: Where the river meets the Ocean meets a lot of iron and concrete - spiraling lap race for Seasharks under the road and rail bridges of South Los Santos. Tight turns and water ramps should make it interesting.

title: Swedish Folkrace
desc: Folkrace is a popular, inexpensive and entry-level form of Swedish rallycross. The tracks are designed to limit the top speed to 50 mph. It's tight, it slams the plate, someone spins and sometimes there are cars left in the berms. Recommended vehicle - Customized Warrener

title: Sumo (Remix) VII
desc: It's time to brush off your territorial instincts in this remix of the classic adversary mode. The bottom line is the same: be in the safe zone when the timer runs out - or prepare to overheat, permanently. But this time, as well as getting smaller, the safe zone changes location every time the clock resets, and bits of the track might disappear at random. Stay sharp.

title: Here Come The Monsters I
desc: Say what you like about gladiatorial fights to the death as a form of mass entertainment - they've got no hangups about being fair. One team takes to the arena in monster trucks capable of crushing metal and bone into the same bloody dust. The other guys get compact cars and a dose of anxiety meds - but if even one of them survives, they win. Let the games begin.

title: Battle of Los Santos LTS
desc: What would happen if two fleets of fighter jets fell into the wrong hands? Find out as you dogfight to the death in the skies over Los Santos. Last Team Standing with 2 teams. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Penitentiary LTS
desc: Two teams on death row in Bolingbroke State Penitentiary. Who's walking out of there? Last Team Standing with 2 teams. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Sumo (Remix) III
desc: It's time to brush off your territorial instincts in this remix of the classic adversary mode. The bottom line is the same: be in the safe zone when the timer runs out - or prepare to overheat, permanently. But this time, as well as getting smaller, the safe zone changes location every time the clock resets, and bits of the track might disappear at random. Stay sharp.

title: Buzzer Beater I
desc: If the years you've spent on the couch lurching from sugar coma to sugar coma have taught you anything, it's this: no deadline, no motivation. Strap a few pounds of high explosive to that deadline, give a small extension for every checkpoint you hit, throw in bonus points for random violence and an audience of millions, and your productivity is about to go through the roof.

title: El Burro Heights
desc: Deathmatch on Marabunte Grande territory in El Burro Heights. We recommend teams for this fight in the back yards and on the winding sloped road overlooking Los Santos. For an authentic experience, get gothic script tattooed on your face.

title: Delta
desc: The lights on the runway in the distance at Fort Zancudo will serve as a grim reminder of the importance of landing during this jump from 2570ft. A steady descent with mostly shallow turns and a couple of dives.

title: Supply
desc: The most action industrial East LS is going to see until it gets redeveloped into retail space, and -loft- apartments for bankers with a creative streak. Deathmatch in the loading bays off Orchardville in Cypress Flats. Works best with teams.

title: Jetty Jumping
desc: Negotiate waves and small islands at this prime surf spot with no surfers. Maybe it's the sharks. Lap race for boats off Paleto Cove.

title: Air Current
desc: The question isn't why you would want to freefall into Los Santos from 4000ft, it's why not? A descent with fast, sweeping turns to ensure that you arrive in style.

title: Spiral
desc: A jump that begins with stunning views of the city and ends with yelling abuse at bankers...does it get any better? A descent from 3900ft with tight spiraling turns around the Maze Bank building.

title: Meuy's Grand Line
desc: Race over the Alamo Sea from McKenzie Field to Sandy Shores and back. Stunt jumps, long straights, track and street.

title: Vinewood Kills
desc: Get properly medieval at a castle-like mansion in Richman. It's got turrets, fountains, and pools - make them run with blood in this deathmatch which works best with teams.

title: Battle of Senora LTS
desc: Desert survival is all about setting clear priorities, and in this case food and water are less important than getting your hands on some tanks and light aircraft. Two teams aim to bury each other in the sand on this expansive LTS in the Grand Senora Desert. You'll need to use everything at your disposal to come out on top. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Stunt - Canyon Fodder
desc: After an expensive lobbying campaign, the race organizers have managed to exempt this race from the yearly San Andreas road fatality statistics. Because if you decide a big ass truck should take on aerobatics, you get what's coming to you. Stunt race for off-road vehicles.

title: Construction Bail
desc: When you are standing on top of a skyscraper in mid-construction with no elevator, there's really only one way down. A technical descent from 880ft with several tight turns.

title: Terminal
desc: Deathmatch in Downtown Port City. Fight between highrise container stacks and under gantry cranes in the Los Santos Docks. The only activity in this part of town you don't need a union card for.

title: HALO
desc: Give air traffic control a wake-up call with this rapid descent into Los Santos International Airport. Freefall from 3950ft, and try to avoid a crash landing.

title: Rebel Rodeo
desc: Inspired by Ken Block's Gymkhana series. Skillfully maneuver around a series of cones, slaloms, 180s, 360s, figure-8s, and obstacles using extreme acceleration, braking, and drifting. Designed to be complex, memorizing the course is a significant part of achieving a fast time.

title: Life Invader Circuit
desc: Tight turns, narrow and wide roads, a smooth hairpin, and fast adrenaline pumping sections are sure to please those who are more serious about racing. Brought to you by Life Invader!

title: Gentry Manor
desc: Lots of plastic surgery? More 70s Vinewood than 50s? Measure of authenticity is how many celebrities have died in the place? Then this is the deathmatch for you. Fight between the bungalows and around the pool of Gentry Manor just off Eclipse. Works best with teams.

title: Here Come The Monsters II
desc: Say what you like about gladiatorial fights to the death as a form of mass entertainment - they've got no hangups about being fair. One team takes to the arena in monster trucks capable of crushing metal and bone into the same bloody dust. The other guys get compact cars and a dose of anxiety meds - but if even one of them survives, they win. Let the games begin.

title: Biolab
desc: Do some inhumane experiments of your own at Humane Labs and Research's high tech facility in the San Chianksi Mountains. Deathmatch at the biolab you might have only seen from the inside. Works best with teams.

title: Skyscraper LTS
desc: There's no escape from Los Santos. One team tries to hold out at the top of a sky scraper construction site armed only with sniper rifles and heavy weapons. The other team launches a four pronged assault in buzzard attack choppers.

title: Jet Stream
desc: Scenic tour of the outskirts of Los Santos... in fighter jets. This long point to point for Lazers takes you past some postcard-worthy landmarks. If you look hard enough, you can make out the tourists taking selfies.

title: Stunt - Bridge Too Far
desc: Between the mayhem and carnage of a track packed with the kind of lunatics who take a swig of Terroil while filling up their tank, is there a better time to truly appreciate the structural integrity of the La Puerta Freeway? No. There's not. Stunt race for sportscars.

title: Chopper Cruise
desc: How do you get from lunch in the Vinewood Hills to your flight at Los Santos International when it's gridlock on the La Puerta Fwy? This Chopper point to point across the city will give you an idea.

title: Jet-setting
desc: When a normal person wants to get out of the city, they have to sit in traffic for hours. Business leaders jump a jet and get out in minutes. Point to point for Vestras heading due North. Over the Kortz Center to Great Chaparral, past Mount Josiah, and all the way to Procopio Beach.

title: Carnage III
desc: There's no need to overcomplicate things: Americans have always known how to have good, old fashioned, rats-in-a-sack, murder-orgy fun. All we need to do is provide a fresh and unpredictable set of tools, roll the cameras, and get the hell out of the way. No mercy, no disqualification, no safe word.

title: Vespucci Shoreline
desc: Isn't it time some minds got blown at Vespucci by something other than medical marijuana? A large, open deathmatch in and around the facilities of Vespucci Beach with little cover.

title: Stunt - Sun, Sea and Chicanes
desc: Experience the majesty of nature as it hurtles by your window in the kind of nauseating blur that's sure to leave a smile on your face and your dinner on the dashboard. Stunt race for classic sportscars.

title: Stage Flight
desc: Lap race for planes in Northern Los Santos County. Starting in the Vinewood Hills, heading North over the Redwood Lights Motocross Track, turning back South over Harmony, going up over Lake Vinewood, down into Downtown Vinewood, and ascending to the Vinewood Bowl. All things Vinewood then.

title: East Vinewood LTS
desc: They don't know how it started, maybe two girls got the same tattoo, or reposted a snapmatic without acknowledging it. What they do know is sides have been chosen, and East Vinewood's gone to hell. Two team LTS in both wide open spaces and close quarters.

title: Tour de Santos
desc: French bicycle races may have lofty alpine scenery, drugged up manorexics and classical architecture, but when it comes to heavy industry, polluted beachfronts, and real criminal activity there's just nothing like a stage in LS. Classic point to point bicycle race through the detritus of the Del Perro coastline.

title: Tight Squeeze
desc: Knife edge between buildings and duck under cranes as you fly by Vespucci, Vinewood, and Rockford Hills. If anything goes wrong, you'll kill some construction workers or package tourists, so who cares, right? Lap race in the Vestra business jet.

title: Take the Plunge
desc: The best training exercises are the ones that kill the most recruits. Get to grips with your backup chute, or find out if water really is as hard as concrete when you hit it at terminal velocity. Two chute jump from 6120ft over the Alamo Sea.

title: First Class
desc: Catch the red eye with this night flight over South Los Santos. Lap race for Vestras that starts by the Maze Bank Arena, ducks under bridges, loops around Los Santos International, and returns over the tallest skyscrapers in Downtown.

title: Del Perro
desc: Multi-level strip mall not that far from the beach. Del Perro Plaza's the perfect place to come for fast food, a restroom break, or a deathmatch. Hose down the forecourt for the next customers.

title: Stunt - A Tight Spot
desc: Does the crushing stress of the modern world leave you feeling like the walls are closing in? Prove once and for all that it's not just in your head when your scalp gets violently sanded by the asphalt above. Claustrophobics need not apply. Stunt race for motorcycles.

title: Grave Danger
desc: Starting in the Puerto Del Sol, go around the whole of beachside West Los Santos in this lap race for choppers. Aerial views of the Vespucci Canals, Richards Majestic Studios, Del Perro, and the Great Ocean Highway.

title: Troubled Waters
desc: What do you get when you throw together more miles of intersections, storm drains, rivers, viaducts, tributaries and spaghetti junctions than anywhere else in the country? Numer one: a staggeringly high number of preventable deaths. Number two: an open invitation to every biker with something to prove. Lap Race.

title: Gordo
desc: Hit all the sights of North Eastern San Andreas in this luscious tour of Mount Gordo, rapidly descending from raised chicanes down to scenic sea level straights.

title: Sea Change
desc: Seashark race from the Alamo Sea to Lago Zancudo. Starts along super-salinated South shore of the Alamo Sea, goes into the Zancudo River, and through the wetlands. Narrow path down waterfalls with tight turns.

title: Rocky Road
desc: Marvel at the untouched beauty of the trees and rock faces of the Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness at worryingly close range. A technical jump from 1630ft, with a slow descent and tight turns.

title: Heli River
desc: Stick to the waterways in this chopper lap race around Los Santos. Follow the concrete river channels and fly under the bridges as you try to beat other birds from Downtown up to El Burro Heights and back to Little Seoul.

title: Project Z Grand Prix
desc: Welcome to Project Z. Test your skills at this varied track, with technical parts, fast cornering, high speeds, challenging corners, chicanes and more. Never lose the pressure and see if you can withstand the test with victory! Keep it clean and fair.

title: Desert
desc: Lonely at the top, lonely at the bottom...this jump starts above the clouds and ends in the desert, so lots of time for existential questions as you freefall from 7870ft, then navigate a series of tight, twisting turns.

title: View of Vespucci
desc: Show some Vespucci beach bums the true meaning of 'spaced out' with this steep parachute descent from 2980ft. See how many checkpoints you can hit before opening your chute.

title: Triphasic
desc: Battle on top of Arcadius business building. These rooftops are perfect to be used as bases. There are three of them connected by container bridges. Sticky bombs will come in handy.

title: Here Come The Monsters III
desc: Say what you like about gladiatorial fights to the death as a form of mass entertainment - they've got no hangups about being fair. One team takes to the arena in monster trucks capable of crushing metal and bone into the same bloody dust. The other guys get compact cars and a dose of anxiety meds - but if even one of them survives, they win. Let the games begin.

title: Chamberlain Hills
desc: Chamberlain Hills is so edgy even the hipsters are too scared to gentrify it. There's only one way to stimulate a housing market this sluggish: a little artificial competition.

title: Raid: Baggage Handlers
desc: Two outfits fight for exclusive import rights at Los Santos International. Get as much of your rival's product back to your base of operations as you can, while they try to do the same. Be careful though, you'll only have Airtugs for transport if you miss out on the three choppers in no man's land.

title: Air Power
desc: Make your own decision about the impact of global warming with this steep, winding jump over the Palmer-Taylor power station from 4120ft.

title: Crop Circle
desc: Explore the Eastern wilds of San Andreas on this point to point for choppers. Go up the coast, round El Gordo Lighthouse, buzz the farms of Grapeseed, and finish in prime alien abduction territory outside Sandy Shores.

title: Crosswind
desc: If it was easy, everyone would be doing it, or at least more people would survive. Advanced level lap race for Besra Jets weaving through the Ron Alternates Wind Farm. Try not to get chopped in half by a turbine blade, or collide with a rival at the crossover.

title: View From Above
desc: Arrive in Los Santos in style with this sweeping descent into the city center from 5419ft, and wave at all the drones in their office cubicles on the way down.

title: Construction
desc: Deathmatch that works best with teams at the STD contractors' site in Little Seoul, soon to be La Puerta Apartments. Hardhats are non-essential as you fight in the foundations of this impressive erection by the Del Perro Freeway.

title: Panic Stations
desc: Bring dog-eat-dog capitalism out of the boardroom and into the streets with this gritty Muscle car race through the banking sector. Laps from El Burro Heights straight through the heart of LS, where cars and credit are fast. Only this time, there aren't any bailouts. No matter how big you are, or how screwed you get.

title: Buzzer Beater III
desc: If the years you've spent on the couch lurching from sugar coma to sugar coma have taught you anything, it's this: no deadline, no motivation. Strap a few pounds of high explosive to that deadline, give a small extension for every checkpoint you hit, throw in bonus points for random violence and an audience of millions, and your productivity is about to go through the roof.

title: Rail Yard, Railed Out
desc: Not just for bottoming out hookers of questionable gender anymore, this La Mesa rail yard is the site of a fierce gun battle.

title: Airstrip
desc: If a recruit shacks it on exercise, they don't need the added humiliation of hitching back to the landing strip. Practice landing where you took off with this flowing descent from 4300ft to McKenzie Airfield. On the way down you can admire the view, or ruminate on failure.

title: Raid: Neighbor Hoods
desc: Have a donkey of a time with this product battle in El Burro Heights. Rival dealers decide coveting thy neighbor's goods isn't such a bad idea after all, as they try to bank their rival's product back to their own base of operations.

title: Trail Blazers
desc: Get in touch with your inner pioneer on this venture into the wilderness round Sandy Shores, where the great frontier traditions of sunstroke, incest and cannibalism have been so lovingly preserved. Off-road race with plenty of jumps along the dirt roads around Route 68.

title: Burn Your Bridges II
desc: Like all sequels, this is more of the same with a bigger budget. Lap race for Vestra jets that weaves between buildings, and gives show-offs seven opportunities to duck under bridges. Be careful not to go down the drain when you go down the drain.

title: Lake
desc: At first you'll think it's the altitude making your eyes and nose water, but you'll soon realize that it's whatever you're breathing in from the Alamo Sea below. A literally mind-blowing descent from 3950ft with banking turns.

title: GTA: Airheads
desc: A team of pilots has to run four stunt jets from LSIA to Fort Zancudo while another team is coming in the opposite direction. Start in your rivals' hangar and use a limited supply of Buzzard attack choppers and Lazer jets to mount a defense... attack is, of course, the best form of defense.

title: The Land Act Dam LTS
desc: The Land Act Dam has been the site of many unsolved murders over the years, including young Vinewood starlet Leonora Johnson in the 1970's, and that tally is about to see a drastic spike. Last Team Standing with 2 teams. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Guns and Gasoline
desc: Parachute jump for beginners. Starts at 4130ft, takes in views of the Land Act Dam and lands between a gun shop and gas station. Kind of perfect.

title: Rancho Projects
desc: It can get kind of heavy in East Los Santos. Nowhere more so than this jungle of project blocks in Rancho. It's Vagos turf, but we suggest you team up. Deathmatch.

title: Holding Pattern
