desc: Every jumper's got to learn to use their back up chute. Either they learn or they go splat with the secondary still packed. Jump from 7874ft, drift down towards the Maze Bank Tower, release your primary chute, free-fall, pull the back up, and land on top of Ammu-Nation in Strawberry.

title: Wind Turbine
desc: You don't need reminding of the importance of harnessing the power of wind when you're crouched by the door of a helicopter at 3280ft, but this jump hammers the point home.

title: From Sky to Sand
desc: Nothing helps soothe the body and calm the nerves after air travel like a dip in the ocean, unless you hit it at 124 mph. Descent from a helicopter at 4410ft above LS International featuring tight turns and a landing on Vespucci Beach.

title: Beach
desc: Sun's up, surf's up, and competition for the best spots down at Vespucci beach is about to get serious.

title: Flying Low
desc: Push your aerobatic stunt jet to its limits with this tricky lap race around the city. You'll duck under bridges, skim the canals, trench run the LS River, and maybe, just maybe, learn something about yourself.

title: RoC Santos
desc: Fast paced street race.

title: River Valley
desc: This 4420ft jump into Raton Canyon is full of dives, sharp turns and moments of questioning what it really is that you're over-compensating for with this extreme sports obsession.

title: Motorboating
desc: A good motorboating is all anyone wants for Valentine's Day. Take your lover for a trip around buoys and over jumps to the North of Mount Gordo. Lap race for water craft. Best at sunrise.

title: Commune
desc: Water the tree of liberty with the blood of people who may or may not be patriots. Deathmatch at the anti-capitalist slash hobo camp at the foot of Mount Chiliad. We suggest teams for this fight in Dignity Village where a ditch separates two groups of outbuildings.

title: Governmental
desc: One of the many ''government facilities'' in the country. Employees at this anonymous building outside the city listen to your conversations, and read your emails for your own safety. Deathmatch at the NOOSE office that works best with teams.

title: Drag Race - Bluff It
desc: The one downside of a drag race on the Great Ocean Highway is the crowd of concerned citizens throwing insults from the overpass. But here’s the thing: If you nail that nitrous and hit those shifts, those guys will be throwing their tighty whities instead.

title: Airwaves
desc: Any student of style will know: what comes up must go down. Drop from 4370ft, tune in to Radio Mirror Park, and pretend you're over all the bands as you twist and turn sharply down to the pond below.

title: Road Tripping
desc: Road trips aren't just three gallon energy drinks, sex with truck drivers, and voiding your bowels on the side of the highway. They're a great American tradition. Celebrate it with this deathmatch along Route 68 - frantic team skirmish among motor hotels of Southern San An for up to 8 players.

title: N.O.O.S.E. LTS
desc: Something's happening behind the mysterious chain link fences, and non-descript 'government facility' signs off the Palomino Freeway. Two teams have taken time off spying on personal communications to fight for supremacy on the rooftops, walkways, and parking lots of the NOOSE facility. Look up for the best weapons.

title: Compound
desc: Test your selflessness with this deathmatch at the Altruist compound in Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness. For once, nudity and wrinkles are only optional.

title: Stab City LTS
desc: Small-scale Last Team Standing for two groups at Stab City. Fight to the finish amongst the glass pipes and empty beer bottles at this Lost MC Hangout. The highest body count this area will see before the arrival of TP Inc.

title: Retaliate
desc: Find weapons through the map and slaughter your opponents.

title: North Rockford
desc: Fight for your life on Prosperity Street Promenade, the rooftops of its stores and clubs, and in the lots behind it. Great opportunity for window shopping, people watching, and mayhem.

title: Stunt - Cluster Struck
desc: Inspired by postmodern nonlinear French architecture, this is what you get when you feed your architect on nothing but Deludamol and Blêuter'd then watch as he flatlines into the scale model.  In other words, a work of genius, and one hell of a stunt race for muscle cars.

title: Bomb Ball II
desc: Let's face it: although you can get behind the naked aggression and anarchic mob-rule, you've never understood the rules of soccer. Well, Bomb Ball gets rid of all those fussy technicalities and restrictions on violence, and boils things down to the real heart of the matter: shoving enormous explosive devices into the other team's half before they go off. Welcome to the beautiful game.

title: Drag Race - Make the Pass
desc: There are three secrets to becoming a drag race legend in San Andreas. 1) Lightning reflexes. 2) Unwavering nerves. 3) Strong cervical vertebrae. On the manic Senora Freeway, you’ll need them all.

title: The Great Adventurer
desc: You've always claimed to be an outdoors person and that one day you're gonna climb Mt. Chiliad. Today your adventure finally begins. So here you are at Los Santos International Airport, in a super car paid for by your rich Liberty City mob boss father, heading to the base of the mountain the only way you know how; driving like an ass with no regard for the environment and those around you. Super car race for up to 16 players from LSIA to the first dirt road north of the Alamo Sea.

title: Bomb Ball I
desc: Let's face it: although you can get behind the naked aggression and anarchic mob-rule, you've never understood the rules of soccer. Well, Bomb Ball gets rid of all those fussy technicalities and restrictions on violence, and boils things down to the real heart of the matter: shoving enormous explosive devices into the other team's half before they go off. Welcome to the beautiful game.

title: Fort Zancudo
desc: Fighter jet battle over Fort Zancudo Military Base in Blaine County. Military exercise or just an exercise in friendly fire. Aerial deathmatch for Lazers.

title: Border War
desc: Cross the border and you're dead.

title: Flag War II
desc: Two teams, two flags, one objective: what's yours is mine, what's mine stays mine. The classic capture the flag formula reworked Arena War style to include enough gasoline-chugging violence to appeal to a mainstream audience.

title: Drag Race - Natural Highs
desc: Drag racing is technically illegal in the state of San Andreas. But don’t worry, the team’s prepared. They’ve disconnected all the cameras and bribed the local cops, so unless you’re thirst trapping on Snapmatic at 150mph, no one’s gonna know…

title: Drag Race - Drag It Out
desc: With nothing standing between you and a clear run down Hawick’s main drag, it’s time to slam on the gas and kick up smoke. Not only is the burnout vital for cleaning your rear tires and providing grip, it also obscures the evidence of the multiple vehicular assaults you committed on the way here.

title: Gauntlet
desc: Sometimes you have to dig a little deeper for those sweet dopamines, and this jump delivers. A rapid descent from 5970ft, leading through tight turns and tree tops.

title: Branching Out
desc: From the sea side to mountain peaks, from hikers to technophobic, cannibalistic cultists, from state parks to secret weed farms, the San Andreas wilderness has it all. Drink it in with this lap race for choppers by Mount Chiliad and Raton Canyon.

title: Flag War I
desc: Two teams, two flags, one objective: what's yours is mine, what's mine stays mine. The classic capture the flag formula reworked Arena War style to include enough gasoline-chugging violence to appeal to a mainstream audience.

title: Wrath
desc: From the feed store to the farmer's market. Fight up and down Grapeseed main street and appreciate this slice of heavily government subsidized Americana. Blaine County deathmatch that works best with teams.

title: Drag Race - Playing Chicken
desc: Want to make it to that finish line? Then you better stick your shifts and pray the G’s wipe you out at just the right moment, because nobody wants to be conscious for the smell of Clucking Bell Farms at 140mph.

title: Contend: Townhall Trinity
desc: Three packages, two teams, one town hall. Albeit the fanciest town hall in Los Santos. If you control Rockford Hills, you control the money, and you control the city, so get the packages back to your base.

title: Grit
desc: Probably the best thing to do out here after tripping on peyote or snake venom. Deathmatch that works best with teams making use of big boulders, Joshua trees, and narrow dirt tracks of the Senora National Park. Should keep the vultures happy.

title: GTA: Grab a Cab
desc: After twelve hours 'rolling' at your local post-industrial techno-house night, your tattooed friends will be too wide-eyed to drive themselves. Pick up some taxis for them in this ultra-exclusive two team GTA style Capture based round the Downtown Cab Co depot in East Vinewood.

title: Games Masters II
desc: When it comes to brutal arena designs, you can install the most exquisitely hazardous death traps on the market, but there's just no substitute for the sheer ingenuity and sadism of a properly incentivized human being. One team collects checkpoints, the other uses every fiendish tool at the arena's disposal to make their plans go up in smoke. And be sure to hold onto your grudges: after every round, you switch places.

title: Legion Square
desc: How do you know when the rush for city center parking sports is starting to get out of control? Well, get your parachute nice and tight, check your SMG ammo, and let's walk it through...

title: GTA: Field of Screams
desc: A tractor shortage in Grapeseed leads to farmyard chaos. It's harvest time, and two rival gangs compete to bring a Fieldmaster tractor back to their bases. Farming is a deadly serious business in Blaine County.

title: Drift Race - Let Fly
desc: LSIA maintain their runway asphalt meets the latest regulatory standards, citing appropriate texture and grooving for steadfast grip. So how would you like to be the case study in their next lawsuit? Lap race for drift vehicles.

title: Drag Race - High n Dry
desc: The LS Tourist Board invites you to explore the natural wonders of the Grand Senora. Discover unique flora blooming in the 100° heat. Come upon inedible fauna clinging to life. Gasp with delight as dragsters smash the Eastern Motel sign. Natural selection is a marvel.

title: Drift Race - A Hill To Die On
desc: According to the celebs on Bleeter, life in Vinewood Hills brings its own unique struggles: BBLs are sagging, next door’s hot pool boy is piling on the pounds, and someone just crashed a ZR350 into the outdoor champagne fridge. It’s a hard life. Point to point race for drift vehicles.

title: Grand Senora Desert
desc: For a long time this place was nothing but stray dogs and trailer parks, but throw in a few oil derricks and suddenly the real estate speculation gets pretty intense.

title: Under the Bridge
desc: Gravity does most of the hard work when you jump out a chopper from 4000ft. We're going to make it a bit more interesting by staging the drop in the flight path, and making recruits go under a bridge. Best played at night, so you can see the warning lights on obstacles.

title: Railyard
desc: As cars and trucks rattle round the complicated mess of Olympic Freeway interchanges above, teams fight for domination in this East Los trainyard. Deathmatch on the tracks and between the carriages in Murrieta Heights.

title: Raid: High Road
desc: Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness: playground for uptight hikers, creepy bird watchers, trail mix enthusiasts and drug runners. Fight a rival crew for the rights to the tunnel shortcut to the Alamo Sea, and put them out of business by taking their product and banking it on your side of the tunnel.

title: Grapeseed Farm LTS
desc: They're no strangers to shootouts at Grapeseed Farm; after all, their main crop is methamphetamine. Last Team Standing with 2 teams. You've got one life, don't waste it.

title: Reflex
desc: Hipsters get violent too. Especially when you call them hipsters. Deathmatch in a Mirror Park mini-mall where you'll see plenty of ironic moustaches. Works best with teams.

title: Timber
desc: A jump like this is a true test of focus and mental strength. Don't allow any ideas to creep in about the slapdash packing of you chute or the odds on a faulty ripcord. No don't, really. This 7870ft descent dives sharply, then twists through the Paleto Forest.

title: Cleared for Landing
desc: Any crosseyed civilian idiot can jump from 6200ft, pull their chute, and land on the blacktop at Los Santos International. But only a rag tag bastard will be able to navigate the tight, twisting turns on this course, leading down to Devin Weston's hangar. For best views of the skyline, play on a clear morning.

title: The Cove
desc: Enjoy the stunning vistas as you rapidly descend towards Paleto Cove by Mount Chiliad... but not so much that you forget to open your chute. Long free fall from 7500ft followed by weaving and diving between checkpoints and the drop zone.

title: Observatory
desc: See if your stars are in alignment with this deathmatch at the Gallileo Observatory. Great for tourists or folks taking a break from cruising young bucks in the Gallileo Park. Works best with teams.

title: Stunt - Smoke Up Your Asphalt
desc: In an effort to distract the health and safety board from endemic violations, the Palmer-Taylor Power Station has agreed to host a tribute to the power and beauty of fossil fuels. The advice? Ride this race like it's your last, because if the jumps don't get you the noxious fumes will. Stunt race for motorcycles.

title: Sawmill
desc: Why is it so important for every criminal gang in the state to be in control of a lumber mill in the backwoods of Paleto Forest. Honest answer? They don't know either, but the other guy sure as hell isn't going to have it.

title: Pursuit Race - Join the Club
desc: This is it, the LS Car Meet's home turf. The eyes of the hottest racers in town are fixed on your first few seconds off the line. Bring a clean pair of tighty-whities because this pressure is hard to stomach. Point to point race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Scrapyard
desc: Come to sell steel to support your downer addiction, and stay for a deathmatch. Fight in the recycling, salvage, and scrap yard under the La Puerta Fwy. Lots of rusty junk for cover. Best with teams.

title: Contend: Condo-monium
desc: Make a statement about late-Capitalism or income equality or art or pointless statements or something by trashing condos in Puerto Del Sol. Contend style Capture going for the last of the party supplies in a courtyard between two identical apartment blocks.

title: Jump Wings
desc: It takes a certain level of self-belief to jump out of a helicopter from 7870ft. This extremely challenging descent, with a series of tight dives, is guaranteed to satisfy your desperate need for exhibitionism.

title: GTA: All Abhorred
desc: Not just for parolees and perverts anymore, a fleet of buses at the Dashound Bus Center in Downtown LS becomes a target for two teams of hoods. They compete to get buses back to their bases on either side of the city, while trying to stop the other team from doing the same.

title: Symmetry
desc: Deathmatch on the roof of a luxury apartment complex in Hawick. Mirrored roof areas with decked sun terraces and swimming pools connected by a narrow footbridge. Works best with teams.

title: Pump Action
desc: The side of the warehouse says no trespassing, no loitering. Splitting into teams and fighting to the death isn't mentioned. Deathmatch that works best with teams amongst the rusted metal and oil derricks in the DEE Oil lot in El Burro Heights.

title: Hold: Freight Fight
desc: Two importers fight over rights to a shipment at the Terminal. Scrappy close quarters battle as they try to get as much product to their side of the containers as they can, and protect it when it gets there.

title: Fleet First
desc: Like every other pilot in LS, you know you can fly a commercial jet under suspension bridges and round Ferris Wheels - now see if you can get your passengers to share your confidence. Drop the oxygen masks and take in the views with this point to point race over some of the most beautiful parts of the state.

title: Raid: Wargames
desc: Like any military operation, when things kick off at Fort Zancudo Air Base, they escalate pretty quickly. Teams hoarding their black market profits raid each other's bases at either end of the facility. If they get the goods back, they're banked. Nothing's off limits to be used here, including the fighter jets.

title: Tag Team III
desc: Arena War isn't all about ruthless individualism. Sometimes there really is safety in numbers - and in Tag Team you're going to need it. Each team has one player in the arena at a time, and their only objective is to immolate the opposition. If you're taking heavy fire you can tag in one of your teammates, but remember, this only ends one way - and it's you or them.

title: Drag Race - Kickin' Sand
desc: You can launch well, you can shift perfectly, you can time your nitrous down to a hundredth of a second, you can be the best drag racer Sandy Shores has ever seen. But the real reward? It’s the friends you write off along the way.

title: Cheetah Grand Prix
desc: Are you quick enough to beat the Cheetah? Engage with the most famous routes guiding you to an alternate dimension, with elegant prop co-ordination taking you through a very unique route. You wouldn't have even thought of it until now.

title: Paleto Bay LTS
desc: What can you do for kicks in sleepy, small-town America? Thanks to the Second Amendment, a whole heap of things. Last Team Standing with 2 teams in Paleto Bay. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: After School
desc: I hope you've learned something at Flight School, because you'll have to prove it in this Race. Watch out, you won't be alone.

title: Forest Mayhem
desc: Hide wisely, things might get hot!

title: Pavilion
desc: Play the murderous missionary with this deathmatch in what's left of old colonial Los Santos. This corner of Alta is now a food fair, Mariachi pick-up joint, and place to pop your friends and get popped by them.

title: Pursuit Race - Industrial Action
desc: As you disappear into the storm drain, don't doubt the path you've taken. Instead, buckle your belt, follow your heart, and remember this one important lesson: You can get anywhere in life if you truly believe, or until a police bike smashes through the windshield. Point to point race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Coastal Path LTS
desc: Pack you some granola bars and a misplaced sense of superiority for this Last Team Standing for two teams on the side of Mount Gordo. Who hasn't wanted to push some fellow hikers off a steep cliff and into the sea?

title: Power Station LTS
desc: A power station opposite a wind farm makes the perfect spot for two conflicting forces of nature to face off. Last Team Standing with 2 teams. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Contend: Salty Snatch
desc: Dog walkers and surfing talent agents look out - two import operations at either end of Chumash Beach are fighting over a shipment that's landed on the pier. Any product they can get to their spot in the sand is theirs to keep.

title: Games Masters I
desc: When it comes to brutal arena designs, you can install the most exquisitely hazardous death traps on the market, but there's just no substitute for the sheer ingenuity and sadism of a properly incentivized human being. One team collects checkpoints, the other uses every fiendish tool at the arena's disposal to make their plans go up in smoke. And be sure to hold onto your grudges: after every round, you switch places.

title: Bomb Ball III
desc: Let's face it: although you can get behind the naked aggression and anarchic mob-rule, you've never understood the rules of soccer. Well, Bomb Ball gets rid of all those fussy technicalities and restrictions on violence, and boils things down to the real heart of the matter: shoving enormous explosive devices into the other team's half before they go off. Welcome to the beautiful game.

title: Hold: Bloody Gulch
desc: Two stickup crews compete for the rights to a Marabunta Grande convoy moving product through Banham Canyon. Whoever can rob the stationary gangsters, get the packages to their evac zone, and protect them there, will win the day.

title: Vespucci Beachfront
desc: Stop the gentrification of Vespucci Beach dead in its tracks with this deathmatch around and on top of the businesses along the beachfront.

title: Tataviam Truckstop LTS
desc: Lonely truckers and enterprising hitchhikers are in for a scare as this pit stop on the Palomino sees its share of the action. Small scale LTS that'll make good use of the Heavy Shotgun.

title: Tag Team II
desc: Arena War isn't all about ruthless individualism. Sometimes there really is safety in numbers - and in Tag Team you're going to need it. Each team has one player in the arena at a time, and their only objective is to immolate the opposition. If you're taking heavy fire you can tag in one of your teammates, but remember, this only ends one way - and it's you or them.

title: Drift Race - Highway Code
desc: What do you get if you smash La Mesa's highway, a can of neon paint, and a deranged mob of juiced-up, burnt-out drifters together? The ultimate city racetrack. And an eight-car pileup. But mostly, the ultimate city racetrack. Lap race for drift vehicles.

title: Pursuit Race - Get Trucked
desc: The sparkling waters of the Land Act Reservoir. The twinkling city lights of Los Santos. And then the epilepsy-inducing flash of a dozen police cars, a helicopter spotlight, and a streak of careening street racers. The Tataviam mountains at night are truly a spectacular sight. Point to point race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Paleto Bay - Tank LTS
desc: Some places get all the luck. Two teams face off with tanks and explosives and don't mind if they turn the whole town to rubble. Who'll be left standing in what's left of Paleto Bay?

title: Storm Drain - Tank LTS
desc: Gang warfare's got really out of hand as two teams come at each other with tanks, motorbikes, and explosives in the concrete channel of the LS River. Try to stay in the storm drain, and don't worry about flash flooding, there's a drought in San Andreas after all.

title: Flying Colors
desc: Regulation Air Force exercises happen at high altitude over the ocean, but where's the fun when you can't get a feel for how fast you're flying? Lap race for planes over rural Eastern Blaine County. How close to the dirt can you go without taking the head off a fruit picker?

title: Grand Senora Desert LTS
desc: USA! USA! USA! Only one side can win this desert Last Team Standing, but if you back America you're sure to pick the winner. Head for the rocks if you want to put on a good fireworks display, and try not to get caught out in the unforgiving open.

title: Drift Race - Wide Berth
desc: The port of Los Santos is the perfect setting to burn and slide into drifting godhood, so don't worry about breaking and entering. Do the docks have nightshift security workers? Yes they do. Are they all shotgunning beers at the finish line? Yes they are. Lap race for drift vehicles.

title: Tag Team I
desc: Arena War isn't all about ruthless individualism. Sometimes there really is safety in numbers - and in Tag Team you're going to need it. Each team has one player in the arena at a time, and their only objective is to immolate the opposition. If you're taking heavy fire you can tag in one of your teammates, but remember, this only ends one way - and it's you or them.

title: Pursuit Race - It's Terminal
desc: You know you're really somebody special when you tour Los Santos with a police escort. Well, that's what you can tell your followers when you post that selfie in a flaming barrel-roll, flanked by NOOSE agents shooting out your windshield. Point to point race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Cape Catfish
desc: The idyllic coast at the foot of the San Chianski mountain range won't be unspoiled by the time this deathmatch is over, as teams battle it out among the shacks and rocks along the shoreline.

title: Flag War III
desc: Two teams, two flags, one objective: what's yours is mine, what's mine stays mine. The classic capture the flag formula reworked Arena War style to include enough gasoline-chugging violence to appeal to a mainstream audience.

title: Senora Airstrip
desc: Take off from Sandy Shores Airfield and fight it out with missiles and guns in the air above Blaine County. Aerial deathmatch for Lazer fighter jets.

title: Trainyard
desc: With only a few minutes before a shipment of seized goods rolls into the station, you can be sure of one thing: every tax-exempt entrepreneur in the city is on the way, and platform space is at a premium.

title: In the Wings
desc: What's the last thing an indicted M and A VP sees after exiting the window of his corner office? Today, it's not his recently repossessed Infernus, it's you and 29 other psychopaths doing laps in military grade jets. Technical air race passing between skyscrapers, through cranes, and under bridges. Welcome to the business district.

title: Desert Storm
desc: Tank exercise in the desert outside Sandy Shores. Crush cans, glass pipes, and rattle snakes as you make tracks and craters through Trevor Philips county. Vehicle deathmatch for Rhinos.

title: Battle of Raton LTS
desc: There's nothing as spiritual as looking out to sea over the beauty of Raton canyon in the morning sun, weeping freely as the tear gas makes its way into your central nervous system. This is a mobile war on many fronts spread across both sides of Cassidy Creek: co-ordinate with your teammates, or risk being divided and conquered. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Pursuit Race - Good Bet
desc: The penthouse residents of the Diamond casino already need three shots of Macbeth and industrial ear defenders to sleep at night. A violent race and chase will only add to the luxury ambience they've come to expect. Don't worry, the valet's seen it all. Point to point race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Vineyard
desc: Wine tasting tours around San Andreas are liable to end badly - mainly because you're stuck in a car all day, drinking from sun up to sun down, and wine snobs are usually a-holes. Ensure your tour ends really badly with this deathmatch at Marlow Valley Vineyard.

title: GTA: Wingmen
desc: It's a buyer's market as rival groups attempt to deliver Buckingham military jets to LSIA. They're vintage collectors' items and they fly like that, so use Lazers for defence and attack. Each team will only have one Buckingham in play at any time. Start points are Fort Zancudo and Sandy Shores Airfield.

title: Buzz Kill
desc: Chopper battle over West Los Santos. Prepare for World War Three with this aerial deathmatch for Buzzard attack helicopters. Takes place over, under and around the LS River bridges.

title: Drift Race - Textile City Limits
desc: New installations, cheering crowds, fresh street art and late-night shows. Textile City's "cultural boom" sounds so good on paper. But then, the PR material conveniently leaves out the stream of drift addicts tearing up the bus center. Lap race for drift vehicles.

title: Urban Jungle
desc: Battle it out in this gang-controlled area of Los Santos.

title: Leap of Faith
desc: When you're standing on the peak of Mount Chiliad, there are two ways down - a leisurely descent in a cable car or a freefall through the initial section of this 2600ft jump at breakneck speed. Time to decide which side of the midlife crisis you're on.

title: Pylon Slalom
desc: Push your Besra to the limit and enter the danger zone as you weave between electricity pylons along the Eastern coast of San Andreas. Aviator shades optional.

title: Pursuit Race - A Real Education
desc: Having established Wegan Wednesday, the ULSA student union are now fighting to abolish sudden movements and outside voices. So, while cutting past campus with the cream of the LSCM and the fat of the LSPD, how about you give them something to really protest about? Point to point race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: B.I.T.C.H.
desc: Beach. Industrial. Track. City. Highway. Enjoy the ride... This B.I.T.C.H. has it all.

title: Drift Race - Beach Slap
desc: Think of those tech bros on their beachfront balconies, watching the sunset with a chilled Cazafortunas in one hand and BAWSAQ in the other. Wouldn’t it be a shame if someone were to drift the backend of an FR36 through their portfolio..? Lap race for drift vehicles.

title: In the Loop
desc: Hold onto your lunch or you'll need windshield wipers on the inside of your cockpit. Point to point for jets through the docks and Downtown. Obstacles to avoid and two loop the loops will keep you on your toes... or your head.

title: Raid: FarmVillain
desc: No strangers to dealers and dead bodies, two outfits try to steal each other's product in the fields and along the 'grow tunnels' of rural Grapeseed. Get a rival's output from their patch and bring it back to yours to bank it.

title: Track and Field
desc: No concerns over doping in this contest: 30 possibly meth-addled bikers show those hallucinations who's boss with some short, precise laps around the Grapeseed. Watch out for the bridge.

title: Under the Radar
desc: Time for night raid training. You're jumping from 4470ft, gliding through a valley on Mount Josiah, and landing inside the military base. Don't forget to pull your legs up going over the fence, or to take your suicide pill if they catch you. Best played at night with a widowmaker chute.

title: Pursuit Race - Groving
desc: Cruising to freedom on the Great Ocean Highway is the dream of every starry-eyed Davis kid. Radio Los Santos up front. Vanilla Unicorn's finest in the back. And the police just a speck in the rear-view mirror. Point to point race for Los Santos Tuners.

title: Drift Race - Smoke and Mirrors
desc: These days, Mirror Park’s considered one of the most desirable neighborhoods in Los Santos and it’s not hard to see why. Where else could you drift sidewise through Horny’s drive thru and grab a quarter pounder on your way to immortality? Lap race for drift vehicles.

title: Movie Set
desc: Ketchup, corn syrup, and particle effects will flow during this deathmatch at Richards Majestic. Do your own stunts as you fight between the sound stages and Sicilian square sets at the movie studio.

title: DEDALUS
desc: Easy.

title: Rancho Projects
desc: It's the little things that give it away. The pitched battles, the caches of automatic weapons, the never-ending turf war. This isn't just some lawless slum. Whoever controls these projects controls the whole south side.

title: Little Seoul LTS
desc: Greed and philanthropy (or is that greed for good will?) fight it out with this two team battle between the Lombank Building and the Betsy O'Neill Arts Center. Columns provide good cover as each side hopes to be the last standing. You've only got one life, be careful.

title: The Flyby
desc: Put on your flight suit and aviators and fire up the afterburners! Test your piloting skills in this low-flying point to point air race for the Western Besra. Start in the Tongva Hills and race through Chumash above the Great Ocean Highway, then buzz a sharp loop around the Fort Zancudo tower on the way up Lago Zancudo. Now you too can pretend you're a Vinewood marine.

title: Vinewood Hills LTS
desc: Tear up the streets of Vinewood Hills and show the millionaires that they're not as segregated from the riffraff as they thought they were. Last Team Standing with 2 teams. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Games Masters III
desc: When it comes to brutal arena designs, you can install the most exquisitely hazardous death traps on the market, but there's just no substitute for the sheer ingenuity and sadism of a properly incentivized human being. One team collects checkpoints, the other uses every fiendish tool at the arena's disposal to make their plans go up in smoke. And be sure to hold onto your grudges: after every round, you switch places.

title: Procopio Beach
desc: Home to an infamous truck stop, Procopio Beach has long been known as a place where people come to blow off steam, and this deathmatch along the shoreline at the foot of Mt. Gordo is no exception.

title: First Base
desc: Troops have been mobilised to deal with an outbreak of charitable giving in downtown Los Santos, leaving Fort Zancudo with just a skeleton crew, and you with the opportunity for some opportunistic slaughter on a grand scale. It may be the biggest airbase in the state, but it can still feel claustrophobic with 30 industrious maniacs crawling all over it in search of each others' blood.

title: Del Perro Freeway LTS
desc: Draw a line in the sand with this Del Perro Beach LTS. Teams start at either end of the beachfront houses. They can go at each other directly or take the pedestrian bridges across the WH to pick up weapons. Dr. Friedlander isn't running his conflict resolution seminar this week.

title: Sprunk Air Race #1
desc: Extreme aerial obstacle course for Mallards.

title: Palomino Highlands
desc: The peace and quiet of the Palomino Highlands... so close to East Los Santos, yet so far away. Until the gang shootout, that is. This deathmatch along the rocky Palomino shoreline is far from a day at the beach. Works best with teams.

title: Elysian Island
desc: Deathmatch at the Los Santos Marine train yard on Elysian Island. Unpack your aggression in the shadow of the Miriam Turner Overpass.

title: Mount Josiah LTS
desc: When the dust settles, and the rivers stop running with blood, who'll be left on top of the second highest mountain in Southern San Andreas? Two teams fight to be king of the hill on the open, almost coverless slopes of Mount Josiah.

title: Refinery
desc: You'll understand why the country's invading oil states and fracking areas of natural beauty after this deathmatch at the oil refinery in El Burro Heights. Be careful of tankers full of gasoline and friends bearing grudges.

title: Richman Mansion LTS
desc: It's a Los Santos rite of passage to spend an afternoon at Richman Mansion gazing at fake breasts and unloading your semi, but now you're ready to graduate from sex to violence with this compact LTS at every voyeur's favorite picnic spot. You've only got one life, don't waste it prematurely.

title: Pit Stop
desc: No rest for the wicked in this traditional team deathmatch just off the Palomino freeway.

title: Casino Royale
desc: Place a bet or two as you hit the casino and bandy about the areas surrounding Mirror Park. Fraught with harsh hairpins and uneven roads, you better gather some courage with this track lest you end up in the bottom of the lake!

title: Property Values
desc: Forget about love, nothing's going to break your heart like the price of real estate. Free for all deathmatch on an unaffordable Cul de Sac near Mirror Park. Look out for the sniper on the grassy knoll.

title: Paleto Beach
desc: The locals complain that not a lot happens in Paleto Bay, so wake up this sleepy town with a deathmatch along the shoreline. It'll keep them in gossip for years.

title: High Overheads
desc: A wise man once said that to really appreciate the beauty of Los Santos you need to be plummeting towards it from 7000ft in the middle of the night. Prove him right with a fast, complex parachute jump that gives you an unparalleled view of the city lights and leaves you exhausted and defenceless on a street corner in downtown Burton.

title: ' # Super Stunt Sky #
desc: Super Stunt Sky. O céu de Los Santos tem mais do que poluição e aviões com pilotos maluco, e você vai ver isso nessa corrida. Thanks for the 800lk likes and 2.2m played

title: Vulture Capital
desc: If you fall off the corporate ladder, it can be a long, long way down. There are no golden parachutes in this Buzzard deathmatch above the Business district. Watch your six, nine, twelve, and three.

title: Raid: Going Coastal
desc: The islets and coves of San Andreas's east coast make it a perfect place for crews to bring product into the country and guns out of it. So perfect that two outfits are competing for exclusive rights for a small stretch of hills and beaches. Raid cash from your rivals and bank it at your own base.

title: Lift Off
desc: Ever wondered why the collective noun for a large group of helicopters is a 'death wish'? Find out with this small-scale, shallow-turning race for up to 30 willing martyrs above the Great Ocean Highway.

title: GTA: Post Op
desc: Rain, sleet or shine, three teams of hoods try to get their hands on some very important letters in two postal trucks at the Post Op Depository on Elysian Island. If they get a van to their spot, it's theirs.

title: Chopper Bombing
desc: From a near-suicidal descent of Mt. Chiliad to a harrowing low-level flight down a raging river to a treetop-trimming run through Paleto Bay, this race will require all your piloting skill.  Point to point for helicopters.

title: Heli Low Fly Zone
desc: Low flying at its best! We recommend 1 lap for a quick par 3 minute race. Weave through the canals of Los Santos, over or under, and dam don't forget to pull up!

title: Through the Gap
desc: Over the years the government has collected enough information on you to predict your individual bowel movements, so here's something they won't see coming: a lunatic drop from 4000ft, cutting your primary chute in time to freefall between the FIB and IAA towers. There's no algorithm for anticipating that kind of stupid.

title: Chopper Killer
desc: This race for helicopters will test the skills of even the best pilots! Rudders are a must to survive!

title: Dusk
desc: Fly past the lighthouse, through turbines, then over the dam into the beautiful city of Los Santos. Good Luck and Have Fun!

title: Corporate Shell-out
desc: Screw insider trading, Ponzi schemes, and disguising toxic assets with derivatives, tanks are the best way to get ahead in the financial district. Every man and woman for themselves in this Rhino deathmatch, Downtown. Uses the upper and lower levels.

title: Shellshocked
desc: The locals like to claim that you can't be too crazy for Vespucci Beach. But Rhino tanks battling it out along the beachfront? That might just test the theory...

title: Humane Labs LTS
desc: Judging from the yellow dense smog and the talking fish in the harbor, Humane Labs and Research stopped making perfume a long time ago. If you run out of ammo on this cramped LTS for two teams, you can always hurl the nearest bucket of toxic sludge at your opponents. You've only got one life, so don't waste it, or they'll use your corpse to test nerve agents.

title: SA Flight School: Racing
desc: Welcome back Doolie, I've got something different for you this time! For this I'm putting you up against some of our other crack-pot pilots. Try to get your ass to the finish line faster than the others. Use what you have learned so far to beat these maggots. If you haven't learned anything yet well you're s#*@ outta luck!

title: Boots on the Ground
desc: Time for a change of regime at Fort Zancudo. Up to 30 bikers splatter their hearts and minds all over the runway. Deceptively simple lap race through an area that's restricted for a reason.

title: Shooting Up
desc: Science shows that the leading cause of death in America is self-pity. Buck the trend with this deathmatch for 30 players set deep in the human waste of Downtown Los Santos. If you can lay waste to the competition here, you'll make it least as far as the insurance industry.

title: Townhall LTS
desc: Municipal government in Los Santos is a simple business: when the people in charge can't be bribed or ruined, they can always be evenly redistributed across the committee room. Get involved in the political process with this LTS for two teams around Burton's Townhall: one crew starts holed up inside, the other launches a three-pronged assault. Expect close and long range fighting. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Banning LTS
desc: One of the few remaining areas of Los Santos where the factory workers aren't hipsters in disguise, Banning also hosts the finest amphibious combat in town. Two teams have come ashore on either side of the naval storage yard: either they fight in amongst the gas holders, or brave the crossing to the SS Bulker on the opposite shore where they can snipe their enemies in comfort. You've only got one life, don't waste it.

title: Basic Training
desc: You've spent all night stowed away in a box car eating rust and chewing your hands just to keep warm, so when the carriage stops and Los Santos embraces you with a merciless gun battle it seems like you've come home. You'll need to adapt to your new surroundings and start to think vertically if you're going to stand a chance in this brutal new world. This is going to be the start of a beautiful relationship.

title: Assault on Cayo Perico
desc: Anyone looking to raid Cayo Perico needs two things: A psych evaluation, and a team of likeminded crazies. Luckily, both are available on the black market. The attacking team must breach the compound and hack the computer. Simple, right? Not so fast. First, they have to navigate the island, destroy the radars, and survive the onslaught of the defending team. The defenders must keep the attackers at bay until time's up. This is high stakes, high risk, high rate of fire.

title: Ship It
desc: Finding yourself breathless and afraid on the LS dockside is an experience that needn't be restricted to sex workers and desperate foreign nationals. This epic jump from nearly 8000ft will give you all those thrills and more as you plunge back to the land of the free. That, or they'll have to hose your remains off the side of thay cargo ship by the landing zone.

title: Dropping In
desc: The contractors who built Fort Zancudo figured that radar coverage beginning at 300ft would be more than sufficient. Prove them wrong with this twisting descent that sets you up for a freefall right into the heart of the base. Don't even think of pulling your second chute until you're inches from the tarmac.

title: ' # Rainbowland
desc: Rainbowlândia, corrida com todas as cores. @ Osiris - T20 - Zentorno - XF - Nero - XA-21 - Visionare.

title: Drift Race - Buckle Down
desc: When the organizers say this race goes from high to low, they definitely mean the track goes from the Galileo Observatory to Downtown Vinewood. If you think they're implying that you'll hit that first precision drift, burst into flames, and barrel roll into the canyon, you're being paranoid. See you on the highlight reel. Point to point race for drift vehicles.

title: Bottleneck
desc: The LS canal system boasts more dead yuppy per square inch than any other water network in the country. Make some well-chosen additions to that statistic with this Deathmatch for up to 30 players that sprawls right across the glorious effluence of Vespucci.

title: ' # LoopWallride DelPerro
desc: Loop + Wallride ao lado de Del Perro Beach. *** IMPORTANTE raspar no container vermelho (hit the car in the red container) @ Osiris Recommended @

title: Farmhouse Fracas
desc: Ask around and you'll find that the O'Neils produce the finest crop of slow, local, organic methamphetamine in any direction. You'll also discover that when the brothers aren't skirting laws concerning acts of bestiality, they're hosting the filthiest Deathmatches in Blaine County. Up to 30 players dart between farm buildings or chance the open ground: Either way, the losers end up as fertilizer.

title: HIT - Biggest Ramp In GTA
desc: I figured everybody likes ramps, so I built the biggest, the largest, the highest, the longest, the most, the best, the EST RAMP ever! Plus I sprinkled a few more ramps around the city. Point to point non-contact stunt race for all Supers.           If you want a custom built Online or Menyoo map, message me on Sclub or Discord.

title: Vineyard LTS
desc: Cutting remarks about the quality of this year's Merlot escalate quickly in this strategic LTS set in the Tongva Hills. Teams begin separated and you can either band together or go it alone, but watch out: wine country is also a sniper's paradise. You've only got one life, get wasted.

title: Drift Race - Go with the Flow
desc: During last year's race season, the local HOA sent a record-breaking number of complaints to the mayor of Paleto Bay. This year, the race organizers are aiming to go even higher. Drop that dirt, ride that wall, fill your lungs with toxic burnout. If they're gonna write 1000 words with caps lock on, you better give them something to write about. Lap race for drift vehicles.

title: Richman Mansion
desc: See how the 0.1 percent live while acting like them and destroying the lives of those who are weaker. Wealth creators deathmatch on the tennis courts, fountains, and manicured lawns of a mansion in Richman. And this isn't even the side of the house where the real action's at.

title: ! RPG vs Flying Cars
desc: This is a game where you need to blow people the F up and then run them the F over and if you don't like the sound of it, then why the F are you playing GTA... Tips - armored cars can take 1 rocket, drive full speed from the start, use homing rockets in case there is a bug and RPGs turn into pistols, use flare guns to counter homing rockets.         If you want a custom built Online or Menyoo map, DM me on Sclub or Discord.

title: Salvage
desc: Return to the scene of the crime with considerably less body armor. Go to the salvage yard in Paleto Bay for a deathmatch and hope the army don't show up.

title: Drift Race - Gang's All Here
desc: LSPD stats suggest gang-related deaths in Rancho have dropped in recent weeks. Perhaps it's undeniable proof that, whether you're team Vagos or team Aztecas, none of it matters behind the wheel. Or maybe it's because the local track skirts the Medical Center so drivers can patch up their stab wounds. Just do yourself a favor, avoid eye contact at the starting line. Lap race for drift vehicles.

title: Bowl Brawl LTS
desc: If you're still standing at the end, you're doing it right.

title: Biolab Redux
desc: With up to 30 players now tearing up the facilities at Humane Labs and Research, our sense of what constitutes a man-made ecological disaster is about to get drastically expanded. Any collateral damage in this facility will put Global Warming squarely into perspective and, as a bonus, you'll probably irradiate those hippies who've been chained to the railings for the past few months. Everyone's a winner.

title: Old School Hits
desc: Alright, listen. I just picked up a new client expanding his operation in LS and trust me, his field out here is crowded. Problem is, these clowns sloppy, and they steppin' on my client's business like it's free space. So here's the job. Before they start pushing new contracts out, you go pay 'em a visit. Shut 'em down, scoop up whatever intel they sittin' on and bring it back at my place. Keep it clean, keep it quiet... my client stays happy, and we all go home without problems.

title: Von Crastenburg LTS
desc: Known as the scuzzy-luxury hotel of choice for its cut-price escort services and high profile assassinations, the Von Crastenburg is also an excellent spot for two street gangs to settle their differences. Get up close and personal with your opponents in the cramped alleys behind the hotel, or wrestle control of the center ground in the multi-storey garage. You've only got one life, don't waste it.
